An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join a high\-impact Transformation Office within a leading organisation. We are seeking an individual who combines the structured problem\-solving and delivery excellence of a consulting background with experience operating within founder\-led, promoter\-led, or entrepreneurial businesses, where pace, agility, and stakeholder management are critical to success.

This role requires a commercially minded professional who can navigate complexity, influence senior stakeholders, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead strategic projects and transformation initiatives from inception through delivery.
* Drive programme governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment against business objectives.
* Prepare executive\-level presentations, business cases, and progress updates.
* Monitor project performance, timelines, budgets, and key deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and business performance.



  





**Requirements** 



* 8\+ years of project, programme, or transformation management experience.
* Experience within a leading consulting firm and/or a corporate Transformation Office, Strategy, or PMO function.
* Exposure to founder\-led, promoter\-led, or entrepreneurial organisations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience engaging senior executives.
* Proven track record delivering complex business transformation programmes.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field.



  





**What's on Offer** 




 A unique opportunity to work on high\-profile strategic initiatives, gain exposure to executive leadership, and play a key role in shaping the future direction of a growing organisation.

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Project Manager – International Projects \& Planning** 
 to join our
 
 International Projects Department to Lead the planning, governance, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of international data centre and infrastructure projects across multiple geographies. The role combines project management leadership with advanced project planning and controls expertise to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with business, contractual, technical, and operational requirements.

data.jd_text:
**Designation: Director, Strategy \& Transformation / Director CEO Office \& Transformation** 




**Location: Dubai, UAE** 




  





**About SUMWON STUDIOS** 




**SUMWON STUDIOS** 
 is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes
 **MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN** 
 and
 **KSTM.** 




  





 In just a few years, we have grown from start\-up to one of the fastest\-scaling brand platforms in the
 
 industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital\-first world.
 



  





 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.
 



  





 The primary purpose of this position is to act as a force multiplier for the CEO and leadership team, increasing the speed, quality and effectiveness of decision making and execution across the organisation.
 



  





 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered. You will lead transformation programmes, drive organisational effectiveness, champion AI and automation adoption, and take ownership of high\-impact strategic projects.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO.
* Independently lead major initiatives with minimal direction.



 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation
 


* Lead the identification, prioritisation and implementation of AI, automation and technology initiatives across the business.
* Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes and operating models using technology.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage.
* Establish a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.



 Organisational Effectiveness
 


* Drive company\-wide OKRs, governance and accountability frameworks.
* Improve decision\-making processes and organisational operating rhythms.
* Help ensure the business scales effectively as teams, brands and markets grow.
* Support leadership teams in defining structures, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Remove complexity and improve cross\-functional collaboration.



 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development
 


* Lead high\-priority projects on behalf of the CEO.
* Support acquisitions, partnerships, market expansion and new business initiatives.
* Coordinate due diligence, integration planning and execution activities.
* Develop business cases, strategic recommendations and implementation plans.



 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.
* Help align teams around business objectives and organisational change.
* Support investor, board, media and external stakeholder communications where required.
* Prepare executive presentations, board materials and strategic updates.



 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.
* Contribute to succession planning and future leadership development.



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience both advising businesses and operating within them.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Experience driving transformation, technology or AI initiatives is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environments.
* Highly organised with exceptional execution capabilities.



  





**What we'll bring** 



* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year
* 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Company social events
* The opportunity to work with a high\-performing team building brands at global scale



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi\-brand platform operating across global markets.

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 As the PMO, you will be the central focal point for the COO to monitor, track, and synchronize all cross\-departmental efforts. Your primary mission is to optimize the Payment Integration Lifecycle and manage the high\-stakes intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Compliance. You will turn strategic vision into a structured, visible, and predictable execution roadmap.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Experience: 5\+ years in Project/Program Management, with 3\+ years specifically in Fintech, Payments, or Orchestration, 1\+ years in Leading 2\+ members team.
* Technical Literacy: Strong understanding of API\-based architectures, Webhooks, and Payment Flow Logic.
* Tools: Expert\-level mastery of Jira/Confluence and specialized PMO software.
* Location Awareness: Familiarity with the fintech ecosystem. And willngness to get into a new locations and learn.
* Strong proficiency in integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation
* Education: Degree in Business, Engineering, or Computer Science. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications are highly preferred.


**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategic Oversight \& COO Support**
* The Focal Point: Serve as the "Single Source of Truth" for the COO, providing a consolidated view of all global projects.
* Executive Reporting: Design and maintain real\-time dashboards (Jira/Monday/Tableau) that track project health, resource utilization, and delivery velocity.
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Lead weekly synchronization meetings between Department Heads to resolve dependencies and resource conflicts.


**Integration \& Product Delivery**
* Payment Pipeline Management: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of new PSP/Bank integrations—from initial API documentation review to Production Go\-Live.
* Process Engineering: Standardize the "Integrations Playbook" to reduce Time\-to\-Market for new payment rails.
* Agile Governance: Partner with Engineering and Product leads to ensure sprint capacity matches commercial priorities.


**Operational Excellence**
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify "at\-risk" projects and provide the COO with remediation options (Trade\-offs, Resource shifts).
* Compliance Alignment: Ensure all projects meet the regulatory  standards of PCI DSS, PSD2 and any specific jurisdiction requirements.


**Job Benefits**
* Competitive salary package aligned with experience and market standards.
* Medical Insurance starting from day 1\.
* Access to training resources and development opportunities that support your professional growth.
* Well\-stocked office with snacks, drinks, and refreshments available daily.
* A multinational organisation that promotes a strong, collaborative culture
* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Tech, Content, Procurement, and Account Management, to ensure a seamless go\-live experience
* Ensure all onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time to facilitate successful launches


**Training \& Enablement**
* Conduct in\-person and remote training sessions for restaurant staff to ensure smooth adoption of Qlub's solutions
* Organize and deliver retraining sessions when needed to address knowledge gaps and reinforce best practices
* Act as a trusted advisor for restaurant teams, helping them maximize the value of Qlub's products and features


**Performance Monitoring \& Adoption**
* Monitor partner performance metrics, including QR adoption rates and transaction trends, to proactively identify opportunities and potential issues
* Troubleshoot operational and technical challenges in collaboration with Account Management, Customer Support, and Tech teams
* Implement corrective actions and provide ongoing enablement to drive long\-term adoption and engagement
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational checks to ensure teams remain confident and effective in using Qlub solutions


**Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Feedback**
* Partner closely with Account Managers to share insights on partner performance and ensure timely communication with key stakeholders
* Gather feedback from restaurant partners and frontline staff to continuously improve processes, training materials, and the overall partner experience
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to identify recurring challenges and contribute to scalable solutions and product enhancements


**What You’ll Own**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new restaurant partners, ensuring a seamless setup experience and building strong partner relationships from day one
* Drive adoption and engagement for newly onboarded partners, achieving and maintaining a target Qlub adoption rate of 45% across assigned accounts
* Monitor and manage the performance of existing partner outlets, proactively identifying opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and overall partner success


**Who You Are**
* You've done this before in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by solving problems and creating exceptional experiences for restaurant partners and their customers
* You're highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail
* You enjoy working directly with customers, building relationships, and helping partners succeed


**What You'll Need**
* A valid driving license and access to a car are required
* 0–2 years of experience in customer onboarding, account management, training, customer success, or a similar client\-facing role
* Proven ability to deliver training sessions and engage diverse audiences effectively
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and coordinate solutions quickly across multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with digital tools such as CRM systems, Google Workspace, Excel, and Google Sheets
* Fluency in English is a must
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly


**Nice to have**
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, SaaS, or technology environments is a strong plus
* Fluency in Arabic is a plus


**What We Offer**
* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast\-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest\-growing restaurant technology companies globally


**Ready to build?** 
 Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

data.jd_text:
**Role Description** 




 The Regional Director – Middle East \& French West Africa will lead the establishment, expansion, and long‑term development of the company’s pharmaceutical business across the Middle East Region and Francophone West Africa. The role carries full regional P\&L responsibility and is accountable for building a scalable commercial platform capable of delivering sustainable growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 The regional expansion strategy will initially focus on establishing a strong presence in Iraq, Senegal, and Ivory Coast, followed by expansion into selected non\-GCC Middle Eastern markets and key Frontier and West African (FWA) markets. Subsequently, the strategy will extend to GCC countries to further strengthen the company's regional footprint.
 



  





 This position represents a senior regional leadership role responsible for developing the company’s commercial footprint, building high‑performing country teams, establishing strong distributor and stakeholder relationships and delivering consistent financial and operational performance across the region.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic leadership with hands‑on execution capability and an entrepreneurial mindset suited to building a regional business in the region.
 



  





**Governance and Reporting Structure** 




 The Regional Director will report to the Group Director International Business and will be responsible for overall governance, operational leadership, and financial performance of the defined region.
 



 Key governance responsibilities include:
 


* Full regional profit and loss accountability
* Development and execution of regional business plans
* Establishment of effective governance and reporting processes
* Alignment of regional strategy with global corporate objectives
* Ensuring regulatory, financial, and operational compliance across all markets



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Regional Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement the commercial strategy for the region.
* Identify and prioritize new market entry opportunities including new countries, therapeutic segments, market segments, and product opportunities.
* Develop multi‑year regional growth plans including revenue targets, portfolio expansion, and market penetration strategies.
* Assess regulatory environments and competitive landscapes across the region.



  





**Market Entry and Expansion** 



* Lead the planning and execution of country launches across priority markets.
* Establish commercial operations in new markets including distributor and promotional agency partnerships, commercial infrastructure, and local teams.
* Expand operations beyond the initial markets of Iraq, Senegal and Ivory Coast, into other regional markets.
* Drive early market entry and rapid product launch strategies.



  





**Regulatory and Market Access Acceleration** 



* Assess regulatory environments across target markets.
* Devise and implement strategies and action plans to accelerate regulatory processes.
* Ensure early market entry and rapid new product launches through proactive regulatory planning and coordination.



  





**Commercial Leadership** 



* Provide strategic and operational leadership to commercial teams across the region.
* Establish clear regional sales targets and financial performance expectations.
* Drive revenue growth and market share expansion across multiple markets.
* Ensure disciplined commercial execution at the country and front\-line levels.



  





**Organization and Team Development** 



* Recruit, develop, and lead strong country leadership and front\-line teams.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and performance across all country teams.
* Drive continuous team development and capability building.
* Promote strong collaboration across commercial, regulatory, and operational functions.



  





**Operational Leadership and Execution** 



* Maintain a hands‑on leadership approach with active involvement in on‑ground execution.
* Ensure disciplined implementation of commercial plans and market expansion initiatives.
* Work closely with distributors and local partners to ensure strong market penetration.
* Closely engage with key opinion leaders and key officers of major medical associations in the region and at the county level.



  





**Business Monitoring and Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement robust business monitoring systems across the region.
* Establish performance management frameworks to track sales, profitability, and operational metrics.
* Monitor business performance against plans and forecasts.
* Implement corrective actions where deviations from plan occur.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting systems at country, region and corporate levels.



  





**Strategic Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Build strong relationships with pharmaceutical distributors and channel partners across the region.
* Engage regulatory authorities and healthcare stakeholders across the region.
* Represent the company within relevant pharmaceutical and healthcare industry forums.
* Identify partnerships that accelerate market penetration and commercial growth.



  





**Cross‑Functional Leadership** 



* Coordinate regional activities across regulatory, supply chain, marketing, finance, and medical functions.
* Ensure alignment between regional commercial strategy and corporate priorities.
* Maintain strong operational discipline and compliance across all markets.



  





**Performance Expectations** 




 Success in the role will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:
 


* Deliver strong regional revenue growth and profitability
* Successfully launch and expand operations across priority markets
* Build high‑performing country leadership teams
* Establish a scalable commercial infrastructure across the Middle East and Francophone West Africa
* Achieve rapid market penetration and successful product launches
* Implement strong governance, reporting, and business monitoring systems



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate must have:
 


* More than 15 years of pharmaceutical commercial leadership experience, including at least 5 years in sales leadership positions
* Significant experience managing multi‑country operations in Africa
* Strong knowledge of Middle East and African healthcare markets
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding pharmaceutical businesses in emerging markets
* Strong financial and P\&L management capability

**About Art Dubai Group** 




  





 Art Dubai Group is a public\-private partnership with Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) founded in 2007, and has grown to become the most experienced cultural programming company in the Gulf.  The group’s flagship initiatives include Art Dubai, the Middle East’s pre\-eminent international art fair; Downtown Design, the region’s leading design fair with a focus on high quality and original design; Dubai Design Week, the region’s largest design festival; and Prototypes for Humanity, the world’s largest and most diverse assembly of academics addressing social and environmental challenges.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Head of Operations** 
 to lead Art Dubai Group's cross\-company functions and drive operational excellence across the organization, with end\-to\-end accountability for operational performance and team management. * Leadership experience with the ability to manage and develop a team.
* Experience within the creative industries, events, or cultural sectors is preferred.



  





**How to apply** 




 Please share your CV via this job posting.

 a week.

data.jd_text:
**Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation** 




**Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA** 









**Objective** 




  





 The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) \- Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects.
 



  





**Job responsibility** 




  





**Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions)** 



* Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions.
* Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs.
* Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand\-over to execution: pre\-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies…
* Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O\&M Contracts etc...
* Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors
* Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor.
* Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design.
* Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents.
* In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical\-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s).
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation.
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O\&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O\&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O\&M philosophy...
* Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project.
* Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close.
* Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams
* Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O\&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews.
* Support the negotiations with the contractors.
* Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities.
* Prepares the technical hand\-over for execution stage.
* Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration.



  





**New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead** 



* Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research \& Innovation (R\&I) programmes and community
* Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics
* Maintains a technology watch
* Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing



**Lead on Engagement of Third\-Party Engineering Consultants** 



* Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors)
* Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects



**Qualification/Experience** 



* Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
* Experience in projects technical development.
* Experience in bid preparation.
* Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT).
* Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus.
* Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS…
* Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms.
* Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O\&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts...
* Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team.
* Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage.
* Experience in desalination will be an advantage.
* Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage.



**Character and Skills** 



* Pro\-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them
* Organized and rigorous
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds
* Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage.



  





  





 ENGIE group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
 



 ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy\-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.

 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.

 — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go\-lives as lead Project Manager.
   

  

 — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification.
   

  

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.
   

  

 — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Support budget and spend tracking for outsourced services, validating supplier invoices against contracted scope, rates, and performance.
* Review and validate variations (e.g., scope changes, ad\-hoc works), ensuring appropriate approvals and change controls are obtained and evidenced.

* Coordinate stakeholder communications for planned works to minimize business disruption and ensure operational readiness.

* Ensure contracts, statements of work, service levels, and change controls are established, current, and maintained.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date supplier inventory for RES UAE, including services provided, locations covered, and governing agreements.
* Support identification, assessment, and ongoing management of third\-party risks, including operational resilience considerations.
* Ensure supplier documentation remains current and readily accessible (e.g., insurance, certifications, relevant H\&S documentation).
* Support due diligence, periodic reviews, and audit readiness in line with the third\-party management framework.
* Coordinate effectively across internal stakeholders and external suppliers to sustain uninterrupted service delivery while managing competing priorities.
* Apply sound judgement under time pressure (e.g., incidents, urgent work), knowing when to act independently and when to escalate.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 About Amazon:
   

  

 Amazon is a global e\-commerce and cloud computing company guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long\-term thinking. We strive to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, Earth’s best employer, and Earth’s safest place to work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and Technical Program Manager to drive innovation and optimization within AMET, leveraging the power of Amazon Web Services (AWS) . This role will be instrumental in identifying, developing and implementing solutions that improve efficiency, improve results, reduce costs, and enhance the overall customer experience. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading complex projects and a passion for leveraging AWS, including AI/ML services, to solve challenging problems. This role will require strong leadership, technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategy Development: Develop and execute a comprehensive automation strategy aligned with Amazon's overall goals, focusing on AWS Solutions. This includes identifying key areas for prioritizing projects and defining measurable success metrics.
* Project Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of AWS\-powered projects, from ideation and requirements gathering to implementation and post\-launch support. This includes managing project timelines, budgets, resources and risks.
* AWS Technology Evaluation: Research and evaluate relevant AWS technologies, including AI/ML services like Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Rekognition, and other relevant solutions like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and Amazon EC2\. Identify and recommend the best AWS services to meet our specific needs.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with engineering, operations and other stakeholders to design and develop innovative automation solutions. This includes defining functional requirements, developing technical specifications and overseeing the integration of new systems within the AWS ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization. Communicate project updates effectively and ensure alignment on goals and objectives.
* Team Leadership: Mentor and develop automation capability. Provide guidance, support, and opportunities for growth, fostering expertise in AWS and SCOT technologies.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor the performance of implemented solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Implement changes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness, leveraging analytics tools.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external stakeholders, particularly those specializing in AWS integrations. Negotiate contracts and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Proven track record of leading and implementing complex automation projects.
* Experience with AWS cloud computing platform and its core services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda).
* Excellent project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, budgets, and resources.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Experience with data analytics and visualization tools, particularly within the AWS ecosystem (e.g., Amazon QuickSight).
* Experience with AWS AI/ML services (e.g., Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Rekognition).
* AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Machine Learning \- Specialty).


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The Senior Technical Program Manager will have the following responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Automation/AI solutions through a sprint mechanism. These ideas should produce savings in hours or cost.
* Deliver Annual roadmap for complex projects that solves important challenges.
* Build AI/Automation capabilities to increase the base of the core team support and scale the program deliverables.
* Maintain program dashboard and P0
* Produce Monthly Program Update.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
**About PFM**
 Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast\-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff. Whether you're a trader, technologist, marketer, or operator \- your work here shapes how thousands of users find and trust prop firms.
   

  

**About The Department**
 UAE Operations \& Regulatory Affairs sits at the intersection of Finance, Legal, and Operations. It owns the integrity of PFM's UAE\-based entity (Prop Firm Match Global FZCO) — governance, free\-zone compliance, banking, tax, audit, visa sponsorship, and regulator\-facing relationships. Our current priority is professionalising the local operating layer so the business can scale internationally without regulatory or operational drag.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Own everything PFM does in the UAE — entity governance, regulatory standing, banking and tax compliance, audit readiness, free\-zone licensing, visa sponsorship, and relationships with local authorities and service providers. Be the senior PFM presence on the ground in the UAE and the trusted commercial\-regulatory bridge between leadership and the UAE ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Performance objectives**
**Objective 1 \- Own UAE entity governance and free\-zone compliance**
 Outcome: Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is fully compliant, in good standing, and audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Maintain free\-zone licence, share capital, and corporate documentation up to date
* Ensure timely renewals, statutory filings, and entity\-level reporting
* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment


**Nice to have**
* Background in fintech, financial services, brokerage, or trading\-adjacent industries
* DIFC or ADGM\-specific licensing experience
* Working Arabic — useful for direct regulator and bank conversations
* Existing relationships with UAE regulators, free\-zone authorities, or top legal / audit firms
* Experience scaling a UAE entity through tax or regulatory transitions (e.g., corporate tax rollout)


**Compensation**
 $6,000\-$10,000 / month gross
   

  

**Reporting cadence**
 Reports to: CFO.
   

  

 Direct reports: None at hire. May grow to include UAE\-based operational staff over time.
   

  

 Key cross\-functional partners: Finance, Leadership, HR, Legal counsel, external auditors and bankers.
   

  

 Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with CFO; monthly written summary covering compliance, regulator interactions, and operational risks; quarterly strategic review with leadership.
   

  

**Location \& work setup**
* Location: UAE\-based (Dubai preferred), with the ability to be physically present at relevant authorities, banks, and the free\-zone office when needed
* Working hours: Flexible, with reasonable overlap with CET hours (4\+ hours of overlap)
* Employment type: Full\-time


**Benefits**
**Hiring stages**
 We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:
   

  

* Application screening We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status
* Video intro \+ role fit questionnaire A short async step \- no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront
* Discovery HR Interview A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals
* Real\-world task (paid) A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM UAE operations or regulatory challenge. We compensate for your time because we believe that's the right way to do it. This stage is designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further
* Peer \& values conversation A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM
* Professional interview You will meet our CFO, to focus on your UAE operations and regulatory expertise — entity governance, banking, tax, free\-zone matters, and how you approach complex regulatory situations. This is the decisive conversation on domain skills and role\-specific experience
* Leadership interview (optional) A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM


 If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
   

  

 To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises \- just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.
   

  

**Before applying take into account that:**
 ▸ If you don't meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires \- we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 ▸ Even if it's not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.
   

  

**Not the right fit for this role?**
 If this role isn't the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area \- we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon works hard to delight customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, \& fluid. Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and when that box with the smile arrived you wondered how it got to you so fast?
   

  

 If so, the Amazon Now team is for you. We partner directly with product and software teams to develop the future of quick commerce.
   

  

 The Tech SME team acts as a catalyst for change by driving innovation at the operator level, prioritizing technology initiatives and supporting engineering design innovations. Tech SMEs strive to be experts in Amazon’s operation systems. They are accountable to delivering world class solutions through optimizing and reinventing the existing technology.
   

  

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams. They will be the single point of contact for all tech related activities related with Supply Chain (SC), Under the roof (UTR) and On the road (OTR) and will be providing regular updates to senior leadership team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes
* Build low\-cost automations using AI tools such as KIRO, Quick, and related operations to drive efficiency and reduce manual processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for improvement of hybrid warehouse management system (HWMS) for inbound and outbound processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for enhancement of delivery service, working closely with the 3P partners \& DSP teams
* Collaborate with worldwide (WW) product and tech teams of HWMS/PRIMS and Last Mile to launch products in Quick commerce (QC) business
* Work closely with the tech organization to document and drive upcoming changes, leveraging tools such as business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure seamless integration with the existing system.
* Provide regular, concise updates to Tech SME leadership on the progress of the system's development and its potential impact.
* Develop the culture of continuous improvement and Kaizen across tech \& operations to optimize processes and reduce SLAs
* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store
* Provide trainings to operations on new systems and processes
* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
