This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of m
data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

STRUCTURAL integrates technology\-driven solutions with specialty contracting services to improve, protect, and enhance the existing infrastructure of owners directly, and in partnership with designers and contractors. STRUCTURAL offers a wide range of specialty repair and maintenance services and is the largest concrete repair contractor in the United States, with roughly 2,500 employees working from locations nationwide and in select international markets. STRUCTURAL is the open\-shop contracting business line of Structural Group.
   

  

**Skills**
 Strong knowledge of company job management (Procore) and forecasting tools. Strong scheduling software knowledge.
   

  

 Possesses solid leadership skills and demonstrated ability to train and mentor. Displays adherence to company operating principles. Supports sales efforts by building and maintaining relationships with customers.
   

  

**Experience \- Field \- Required/Preferred**
 5\+ yrs \- Construction Management / Civil Engineering \- Required
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ability to manage generally 3\-6 projects at a time
* Successfully manages projects of moderate complexity that have an aggregate value generally in the range of $1\-$5million.
* Effectively manages changed conditions on projects of moderate complexity including knowing our contractual rights, providing proper notice to third parties and other measures to minimize risk. Estimates and prepares change orders. Coordinates change order review with estimating
* Negotiates and resolves minor disputes relative to authority limits
* Knows the importance of financial management on projects. Has developed strong skills of production tracking and analysis, billing, forecasting, and percent complete accounting. Understands the importance of the month\-end process and is fully prepared with all information including in\-depth explanations for margin variations and over/under billings. Can draw relationships between CPM schedule and forecasting and utilize effectively to monitor project. Monitors cash flow and routinely follows up on open accounts receivable
* Understands Critical Path Method sequencing, work task relationships and resource loading; Maximizes schedules for the benefit of the project
* Dedicated to 24/7 safety culture. Communicates expectations regarding our safety culture and holds others accountable to it on project level
* Dedicated to quality as a core value and communicates expectations regarding our quality culture and holds others accountable to it on a project level
* Interprets, plans, and executes specification requirements of moderate complexity. Negotiates basic contract / subcontract T\&C. Ability to evaluate risk and loss exposure on projects managed.
* Assists in planning, directing, and supervising daily activities of the resources of projects assigned. Maintains open communication with the Branch leadership.
* Effectively communicates expectations and holds team members accountable.
* Works with Jobsite Superintendents/Foremen to coordinate the efforts of any technicians or subcontractors
* Determines labor requirements and dispatches workers to construction sites.
* Develops budgets, evaluates historical man\-hour production rates, tracks actual job production rates and material costs, analyzes this data to report current job costs, accurately forecasts job progress by creating look\-ahead schedules, and uncovers any items that might negatively impact the schedule or budget.
* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work and the work of others.
* Develops, implements, and maintains quality control plans on the job to minimize punch\-lists at the completion of the project.
* Interprets and explains plans and contract terms to administrative staff, workers, and clients, represents the owner or developer.
* Schedules and facilitates detailed pre\-planning of projects and pre\-task planning for activities.
* Hands\-on mentor and coach, team\-oriented and solution\-oriented.
* Identifies, assigns, and maintains company equipment as necessary to perform the assigned task. Assures that equipment maintenance plans are developed and implemented on projects.
* Maintains Profit \& Loss responsibility over multiple projects and makes key decisions \& recommendations on projects from pre\-task planning phase through closeout.
* Maintains quality control on the job to minimize punch\-list at the completion of the project.
* Manages all project change orders. Identifies changes and provides timely notice to branch leadership. Negotiates and prepares change order agreements. Assesses each project from a long\-term perspective. Anticipates changes/impacts, which may result in delays/claims, etc. and communicates these changes to the client.
* Manages superintendents/foreman, subcontractors, technicians at the level required to meet the division or branch goals. Ability to work under pressure and coordinates numerous activities and groups in order to establish cooperation and achieve maximum efficiency.
* Negotiates with and manages subcontractors and materials suppliers and stays informed on subcontractor scope of work and technical specifications. Prepares and executes subcontractor agreements.
* Monitors/Assesses performance of self, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.
* Orders materials in a timely fashion to allow work to progress productively. Negotiates and executes material purchase orders.
* Prepares contracts and negotiates revisions, changes, and additions to contractual agreements with architects, consultants, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. Obtains all necessary permits and licenses. Works with and serves as the primary point of contact to the customer.
* Prepares, updates and analyzes project schedules using CPM techniques.
* Prepares formal letters \& other written communication to customers/owners. Responsible for project documentation (including but limited to: phone conversations, site visits, meetings, etc.). Performs close\-out reports for all assigned projects.
* Prepares and maintains project submittals, RFI, communications, change orders and other appropriate tracking logs.
* Ability to recognize changes to the as bid project scope of work.
* Confers with supervisory personnel, owners, contractors, and design professionals to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, complaints, and construction problems. .
* Reviews and negotiates contracts, change orders, subcontractor contracts. Oversees and evaluates billings, as\-builts, budgets, purchases, production tracking, operational planning, development of project schedule, assignment of manpower, communication with engineers and clients, claims management, quality control as related to project schedules, plans and or specifications.
* Meets with Superintendents/Foremen at least weekly to review job progress.
* Schedules, prepares and facilitates project team, project owner, and jobsite meetings.
* Studies job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
* Takes appropriate action to deal with the results of delays, bad weather, or emergencies at construction sites
* Tracks and controls construction schedule to achieve completion of all projects within time and financial goals.


**Essential Safety Duties**
* Essential Safety Duties
* Assures all PPE required by safety specs and company policies is worn by employees, subcontractors and site visitors
* Assure subcontractors are adhering to Company safety policies and culture
* Communicates expectations regarding our safety culture and holds employees accountable
* Performs work in strict compliance with jobsite/shop requirements and the Field Guide to Better Safety
* Accountable for the continuous improvement of branch and division safety programs
* Understands the principles of Safety 24/7 and empowers his/her team toward reaching its safety goals
* Examines/inspects work progress, equipment, and jobsites to verify safety standards are met
* Ensures jobsite/shop is maintained in a safe manner
* Performs root cause analyses and utilizes findings as a training tool for branch employees
* Performs Safety Assessments specified by jobsite
* Promotes 24/7 Safety Culture and exhibits a Safety 24/7 attitude in all situations
* Provides leadership/guidance in developing/continuously improving safety protocol in the field/shop
* Reports immediately, accurately and in full detail all incidents
* Reviews findings at end of the inspection with jobsite employees
* Reviews subcontractor safety reports and assists in sharing progress with client and operations team
* Reviews/audits all safety documentation and investigations and develops safety program changes
* Sets an example for others by demonstrating that safety is a core value
* Sets individual as well as division/branch annual safety goals
* Trains project team members on how to properly conduct JSA's, SOR's and recognize near hits.
* Frequently visit projects to ensure that safety policies are being abided by
* Wears all Personal Protection Equipment required by safety specifications


**Physical Requirements**
* Able to pass a respirator fit test and wear a respirator when required on specific jobsites
* Performs physical activity that requires considerable use of arms, legs, and moving whole body
* Dexterity of hand and fingers to operate a computer, small hand\-held power tools, office equipment
* Required to lift, push, pull, or carry objects up to 25lbs without assistance
* Physical capability to operate motor vehicles and/or heavy equipment
* Able to speak and hear detailed information through oral communication
* Has visual acuity to see items clearly and sharply and to recognize small detail


**Special Requirements**
* Ability to Travel \- Up To 50%
* Willing to work 50\-55 hour per week and have flexible work hours
* Willing to work at heights up to 650 feet off the ground
* Possess valid driver's license in order to operate rental cars when traveling for company business


 STRUCTURAL is committed to a Safety 24/7 culture and offers competitive compensation and benefits including medical, dental insurance, 401(k), paid holidays \& vacation, tuition reimbursement, career development and growth opportunities, and a caring work environment. EOE/M/F/D/V

data.jd_text:
You've shaped a compelling academic vision in the past and taken full ownership of the results. You've led visibly, not from behind the curtain. And when it comes to learning science, you're not experimenting—you've built something tangible, delivered outcomes that validate the approach, and earned the credibility to present your work publicly. If this describes you, 2 Hour Learning is seeking its academic leader.
   

  

 At 2 Hour Learning, we've developed a system in which students learn at twice the speed in only two hours per day. AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-oriented progression, and a complete rethinking of traditional classroom design underpin these results. The performance is remarkable. We now need a leader who can standardize execution across varied school environments, elevate academic leadership standards, and serve as the public advocate for a movement rooted in sound learning science.
   

  

 This is not a position for academic theorists. It's a leadership charge. You will own the academic strategy in practice, define precise standards, surface execution shortfalls, and mentor high\-caliber teams to achieve tangible outcomes. You will convert our scientific principles into operational rigor and champion this model on a global stage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that transform learning science into actionable direction for curriculum design, motivation architecture, and application development.
* Conducting academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to ensure school teams remain aligned, accountable, and results\-focused.
* Integrating data, stakeholder interviews, and direct observation into comprehensive academic ecosystem assessments that pinpoint the most impactful obstacles to accelerated learning and recommend targeted interventions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through structured planning, continuous feedback, and milestone oversight to sustain focus on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the external face of 2 Hour Learning in high\-profile forums, from keynote presentations to engagements with Ministries of Education, advancing systemic transformation in global education paradigms.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Making incremental adjustments to isolated curriculum initiatives without producing systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research that lacks direct connection to student performance or operational implementation.
* Transferring accountability for outcomes to mid\-level managers or external advisors.
* Depending on institutional reputation or theoretical arguments to convince critical audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and strengthen 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by standardizing execution across multiple school sites, raising leadership performance expectations, and establishing yourself as the authoritative public voice of a movement built on rigorous science and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. The Head of School – Computing is a key academic and administrative leadership position at TAG\-ME, Curtin University Dubai. The role involves overseeing the development, implementation, and management of the School of Computing, ensuring alignment with Curtin’s global academic standards and institutional goals. The Head of School will work closely with the Director Learning and Teaching at Curtin University Dubai, faculty members, professional staff, Curtin University Perth and students to foster a collaborative and high‑quality learning environment while supporting the growth of computing programs at Curtin Dubai.
 



  





**Leadership and School Ownership** 



* Provide overall leadership of the School of Computing. Take ownership of the school’s academic performance, strategic direction, growth, and market positioning, in line with Curtin Dubai’s objectives and strategy.
* Develop and implement a 3\-5 year roadmap for the school covering enrolment growth, program development, research, student outcomes, and industry engagement.
* Work closely with the Pro Vice\-Chancellor \& President, Director – Learning and Teaching, other Heads of School, professional services teams, and Curtin Perth faculty leadership to support institutional and school priorities.
* Build effective working relationships with Curtin Perth Faculty leadership, Heads of School, Deans, Unit Coordinators, and other academic staff.
* Identify emerging and high\-demand areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Digital Transformation, and related fields to strengthen the School’s program portfolio.
* Support the expansion of postgraduate programs, micro\-credentials, executive education, and other industry\-aligned offerings.
* Be accountable for the School’s overall performance, including enrolment growth, academic quality, student satisfaction, progression, retention, graduate outcomes, and industry relevance.



  





**School and Program Management** 



* Oversee the day\-to\-day academic and administrative operations of the School of Computing.

data.jd_text:
Eaton’s ES EMEA CPS division is currently seeking a Program Manager Direct Current for Data Center (DC for DC) EMEA.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The DC for DC EMEA Program Manager is responsible for orchestrating and governing Eaton’s end to end data center electrical solution portfolio for hyperscale and colocation customers across EMEA. This role ensures that product development, system architectures, and customer engagement activities across multiple Eaton divisions are aligned into a coherent, competitive, and execution ready offering.
   

  

 Operating as a senior, technical program leader with strong systems engineering credibility, the Program Manager leads through influence across R\&D, product management, engineering, and commercial teams. The role owns program execution from concept through launch, ensuring on schedule and on budget delivery, structured customer engagement at each development milestone, and rapid identification and resolution of technical or organizational gaps.
   

  

 This is a newly created, strategic role reporting directly to the VP/GM, with a mandate to strengthen Eaton’s position with hyperscalers and colocation customers by driving integrated solutions rather than disconnected products.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**DC for DC EMEA Program Leadership:**
* Establish and lead the DC for DC EMEA program covering Eaton’s full data center power value chain, including MVSST, 800VDC Switchboard, DC Remote Power Panel, Solid State Breakers, BESS, Busway, digital power management, and related software and services.
* Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
* Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.


**Cross Division Product \& Technology Alignment**
* Coordinate new product development roadmaps across multiple Eaton divisions to ensure architectural coherence and compatibility for hyperscale and colocation data center applications.
* Work closely with divisional R\&D, power systems engineering, and product management teams to align technical assumptions, interfaces, and performance targets.
* Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


**Customer Engagement \& External Alignment**
* Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
* Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
* Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.


**Program Execution, Visibility \& Issue Resolution**
* Consolidate inputs from divisions into clear program dashboards, executive summaries, and decision materials for senior leadership.
* Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
* Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.


**Strategic Contribution \& Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute to Eaton’s long term data center strategy by providing insights from customer engagements, competitive dynamics, and technology trends.
* Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
* Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
* Prior experience in R\&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


**Skills**
* Strong understanding of data center electrical architectures, including MV and LV distribution, ACBs, UPS systems, energy storage, busway, and redundancy concepts.
* Ability to ensure system level technical coherence through collaboration with divisional experts rather than hands on detailed design ownership.
* Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.
* Strong program management discipline and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate confidently with senior internal leaders and demanding external customers.
* Structured, action oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution and issue resolution.
* Excellent written and spoken English.


 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

data.raw_snippet: The Center for Arabic Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies,
data.jd_text:
The Center for Arabic Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To manage and grow relationships with large and strategic clients within the assigned portfolio in the Retail \& Consumer Goods segment of Wholesale Banking. Drive new business origination while ensuring full compliance with Credit and Risk frameworks. Improve service quality levels and supervise the day‑to‑day activities and client interactions of subordinates to ensure the team consistently meets its objectives and achieves revenue targets, while maintaining strong client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. Promote effective cross‑functional collaboration to deliver integrated financial solutions. Achieving financial targets and strategic objectives will be essential in driving sustainable growth and maintaining profitability.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to execute deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Draft Term Sheets, Information Memorandums, Mandate letters etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions.
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields and sufficient ancillary business.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring quality service and effective resolution of issues.
* Prepare briefing note memos ahead of senior management meetings with clients.
* Engage with internal stakeholders to obtain approvals for client RFPs in a timely manner.
* Increase wallet share with existing clients through strategic engagement and product penetration.
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Be knowledgeable on market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Retail \& Consumer Goods team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Present transactions/proposals to the Credit Allocation Committee (CAC) for approvals.
* Run deal RAROCs and draft CAC submissions, ensuring delivery on CAC promises to achieve target RAROC thresholds.
* Prepare Green Light Memos for deal screening and Client Credit Applications (CAs).
* Review CAs and draft relationship comments before submission to Credit Committees.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Address Credit inquiries, liaise with CAD and Legal for documentation matters.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Retail \& Consumer Goods group and Retails \& Wholesale team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short\- \& long\-term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.

-

**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or Investment Banking with exposure to Retail \& Consumer Goods.

* Excellent relationship management, negotiation, and leadership skills.

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.

* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.

 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply
   

  

 In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and the names and contact details of three professional references.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

data.jd_text:
**Your new company** 




  





 We are working with a cutting\-edge, research\-driven FinTech company backed by a prominent family office. Specializing in advanced, AI\-powered investment and allocation strategies, they combine mathematical modeling, portfolio optimization, and risk analytics to build a sophisticated SaaS platform.
 



 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.
 



  





  





**Your new role** 




 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.
* Excellent technical literacy—the ability to understand engineering workflows, ask the right questions, and hold people to their commitments.
* A solid understanding of the
 **finance industry, financial markets, or private equity** 
 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.



  





  





**What you'll get in return** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation. You will receive a highly competitive compensation package tailored to your experience. For the right international candidate looking to make a long\-term commitment to Dubai, comprehensive relocation support is available.
 



  





  





**What you'll need to do now** 




 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

**Company Description**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI\-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The role of the Expert Services MEA Practice Director will oversee a team of consultants responsible for delivering high\-quality outcomes to our customers and partners across all the Workflows. This role reports to the Director, Expert Services MEA and plays a pivotal role in shaping and executing the delivery strategy for MEA Expert services and delivery high\-impact programme across the region.
   

  

 What you get to do in this role
   

  

* Define and execute the MEA Expert Services delivery strategy, aligned with customer needs, market trends, and ServiceNow’s business goals. Drive decisions around capability development, service offerings, delivery models, and market positioning.
* Champion transformation delivery and customer success: Ensure delivery efforts are aligned to customer business outcomes, platform adoption, and long\-term success. Position the practice as a strategic partner for MEA transformation journeys.
* Lead and grow a high\-performing team of senior leaders and consultants, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Set up operational infrastructure, SLAs, governance frameworks, and performance metrics for the nearshore/ offshore delivery center anchoring the practice. Implement capacity planning, resource allocation, and demand forecasting to enable scalable, quality\-driven delivery across MEA.
* Manage partner execution through clear expectations, weekly cadence reviews, and escalation protocols. Partner with global delivery partners and ServiceNow Partner Alliance Teams to co\-deliver on customer outcomes, align on delivery standards, and drive continuous improvement.
* Translate market demand, sales pipeline insights, and strategic initiatives into action—driving decisions around hiring, team structure, capability development, and enablement.
* Own the technical solution quality of delivery in MEA engagements, ensuring consistent, scalable, and value\-driven outcomes for our customers.
* Position the team for scale by developing delivery models, frameworks, and leadership capabilities that support predictable and high\-quality customer success.
* Partner with Product Business Units, Sales, and Customer Success to accelerate value realization, inform product strategy, and co\-drive strategic initiatives.
* Align with Expert Services counterparts to share learnings, shape global initiatives, and bring best practices into the EMEA organization.
* Provide strategic leadership and mentorship to senior team members, supporting the resolution of complex challenges and the development of future leaders.
* Champion customer transformation journeys—ensuring delivery efforts are aligned to business outcomes, product adoption, and long\-term success.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence, continually evolving best practices, offerings, and delivery methodology.


 Key Performance Measurements
   

  

* Contribution to Expert Services business outcomes (revenue, margin, growth).

* Customer satisfaction, Expert Services value realization, and adoption metrics.
* Team readiness, capability development, and leadership bench strength.
* Impact of strategic initiatives across sales, delivery, and product alignment.


**Qualifications**

 Strategic Leadership \& People Development
   

  

 Proven experience leading senior\-level teams, including managers and consultants, in a professional services or consulting environment within MEA region
   

  

 Strong cross\-functional collaborator who thrives in a matrixed, global environment.
   

  

 Passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing diverse audiences from consultants to C\-level executives.
   

  

 Additional Qualities for Success
   

  

 A strategic thinker with a transformation mindset, focused on long\-term business impact.
   

  

 Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical delivery to commercial impact and product evolution.
   

  

 Experience driving adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and automation, in the context of enterprise service delivery.
   

  

**Technology \& Domain Knowledge**
* Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform or comparable enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, Workday); certifications or ecosystem experience is a plus.
* Experience engaging directly with executive\-level customers and partners, advising on transformation strategy and value realization.
* Strong ability to assess market demand, interpret sales pipelines, and translate commercial opportunities into delivery readiness and team investments.
* Deep understanding of consulting methodologies, such as Now Create, Agile, and value\-based delivery approaches.
* Expertise in structuring scalable delivery models and driving operational excellence across customer\-facing teams.
* Consulting \& Service Delivery Expertise
* Significant experience delivering or overseeing large\-scale digital transformation engagements, with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Experience collaborating with partners and third party setting up nearshore/offshore delivery model


**Strategic Partners and Delivery**
* Experience setting up and managing nearshore and offshore delivery centers building ServiceNow implementation capability
* Executive presence and influence, with the ability to communicate clearly, inspire trust, and align diverse stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Strong ability to mentor senior leaders, promote leadership development, and build succession plans for sustainable organizational growth.
* Track record of hiring, scaling, and enabling high\-performing teams with diverse skill sets, while fostering a culture of excellence, inclusion, and innovation.
* Demonstrated success in defining and executing regional or global strategies, ideally in the context of enterprise technology or digital transformation.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here.  We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Director Customer Experience \& Innovation Consulting
   

  

 As a Senior Leader, CX \& Innovation Consulting, you will be responsible for the growth, development, and execution of experience and innovation strategy services across the MENA region and beyond. You’ll work in partnership with Experience \& Innovation capability leads within the region. The role requires working from client offices across the GCC, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Oman.
   

  

 The role works at the intersection of strategy and design and will focus on driving opportunities within the C\-Suite and senior management teams. You will be responsible for shaping opportunities through the customer and market lens to accelerate value identification and value realization for clients. To do this, you will bring together a range of experts to help clients define and shape amazing customer value propositions, new propositions and experiences and even wholly new businesses. You will do this from within the Experience \& Innovation capability group, but working in partnership with Management Consulting, Engineering, Data and our Product capability groups.
   

  

 Publicis Sapient has clients across several industries spanning Financial Services, Energy, Government, to Travel. Deep expertise in some of these industries, especially in Financial Services, is particularly favoured.
   

  

 You will be involved in originating, shaping, and driving transformational strategies from inception through to budgeting and implementation working alongside Publicis Sapient’s proven digital transformation technology teams. As a senior leader within the team, you will also be involved in shaping and growing the focus and strategy of Publicis Sapient’s experience offering itself. You are an entrepreneurial leader who balances strategic vision with operational rigor—owning the end\-to\-end product lifecycle to ensure our work delivers measurable business and customer impact.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 You will have at least 15 years of CX and Innovation Consulting experience, ideally working within a major consulting, digital or design firm. Deep customer research and analytics skills is core to your DNA, as is the use of service design / design thinking to drive product strategy and innovation. Prior experience within programs and strategies with multi\-million dollar and global scale and reach is expected. Also expected are skills, interest and experience in technology and using technology to drive value accretive experience\-led transformations.
   

  

 As a Senior Leader, you will be expected to drive business development around diverse range of spaces from digital business transformation strategy, customer experience transformation, employee experience, new product, and service innovation, and moving into broader complex system strategy and design as well as much, much more.
   

  

 To do this, Publicis Sapient are actively investing within the MENA region to build out the team.
   

  

 As a lead you will be evaluated based upon your impact on the capabilities of the team, the work, and the commercial contribution of the broader Experience group within the region in collaboration with the other leaders.
   

  

**Core Consulting \& Leadership Capabilities**
**Strategic \& Commercial Leadership**
* Business Development: Lead business development efforts, including identifying opportunities, shaping proposals, and leading pitches for new and existing clients. Cultivate trusted advisor relationships with C\-level clients to grow accounts year\-over\-year.
* Financial \& Commercial Management: Understand P\&L for your practice area. Manage financial forecasting, utilization, profitability, scope, margins, and resource allocation to ensure the commercial success of engagements.
* Market Presence: Act as a thought leader in Strategic Design and Innovation across the MENA region, representing Publicis Sapient at industry events and building a network that drives business opportunities.
* Domain Authority: Leverage deep expertise in Financial Services, Energy, Government, or Travel to engage credibly with clients on their business challenges and translate industry dynamics into transformative opportunities.


**Team Leadership \& Culture**
* Team Development: Lead, mentor, and scale a diverse experience team of CX strategists and designers. Foster a culture of innovation, high performance, and impact while actively managing career development, retention, and recruitment.
* Operational Management: Oversee resource allocation and utilization across the team to ensure optimal billability and project profitability, balancing client delivery needs with professional growth opportunities.
* Team Player: Excellent collaborator who is well organized and balances strategic vision with operational rigor.


**Customer Experience \& Product Lifecycle Management**
* End\-to\-End Lifecycle Authority: Lead client engagements across the entire product lifecycle—from early\-stage strategy and value proposition design, through experience definition, to delivery, launch, and post\-launch optimization. Ensure continuity between what is designed for the customer and what is built.
* Craft Mastery: Deep expertise in design thinking, systems thinking, user research, service design, and the creation of strategic artifacts (visioning/strategic illustrations, personas, journeys, blueprints) to drive business outcomes, not just outputs.
* Experience Strategy \& Delivery driven by AI: Leverage design thinking and systems thinking to uncover high\-value opportunities, expedited and elevated through AI tools.
* Research \& Insights: Champion rigorous qualitative and quantitative user research throughout the lifecycle to de\-risk decisions and inform product roadmaps from concept through to live measurement.
* Storytelling: Comfortable influencing client decisions on strategy and implementation using both narrative and quantitative analysis. Strong communicator and moderator, skilled at finding common ground and advocating for customer value and business solutions


**Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 15\+ years in customer experience, product strategy, or digital transformation, with a minimum of 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director level or above) within a top\-tier consulting firm, digital agency, or product organization.
* Proven Track Record:
* Building, managing, and scaling CX teams, including managing team finances, utilization, and P\&L.
* Growing client accounts and winning new business, including leading proposals, pricing strategy, and client negotiations.
* Managing the full product lifecycle—from strategy and discovery through delivery and post\-launch measurement.
* Owning and driving CX \& Innovation project revenue.
* Skills:
* Creative and analytical problem solver.
* Excellent written, verbal, numerical, and presentation skills.
* Strong appreciation for new technology, data platforms, Agile ways of working, and modern technology tools and methods.
* Travel: Willing to travel or be at client site at least 80% of the time across the MENA region (in particular Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Oman).
* Language: Business\-level fluency in English.


 Set Yourself Apart With
   

  

* Experience working in Saudi and/or UAE
* Hands on experience with managing product management and UI/UX design teams and work Financial Services expertise


 Additional Information
   

  

* Fully paid annual leave of 22 working days
* Free private health insurance extended to employee and direct dependents
* Return air ticket to home country per year to employee and direct dependents
* Schooling allowance offered based on the policy


**Company Description**
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start\-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem\-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000\+ people in 72 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

data.jd_text:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
