data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through our global hub in Dubai, and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers 'Fly Better’.
   

  

 Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting\-edge information and technology team as an
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 .
   

  

 We are hiring a Delivery Manager with strong experience in Aviation Cargo or Logistics to lead large\-scale, AI\-driven in\-house development initiatives. The role also requires proven expertise in managing RFT processes, vendor selection, and end\-to\-end implementation of technology solutions. The ideal candidate will drive delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and innovation across complex, multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

 As the
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 , you will be responsible for planning, leading, organising, and motivating scrum teams either within a Release Train or outside to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high\-visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid (for Package Acquisition) methods in a fast\-paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, processes, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done, practicing servant leadership, and encourage discussion, decision making,g and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team\-level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensure each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g., ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work, leveraging cross\-functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput, and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both the product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance, and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements, etc., and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation/sizing exercise for both near\-term and future initiatives, and assist with preparing the total cost of ownership with the product team, maintain the actuals within the allocated budget, and ensure that forecasting for all the demands is accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* A Degree or Honours (12\+3\) or equivalent in Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience within Information Technology with proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programme.
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, PRINCE2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery, e.g., ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large\-scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty, and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Aviation Cargo or Logistics domain experience is preferred.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance, and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior technology leader to scale and expand our financial technology platform as the company expands across markets, products, partners, and regions.
 



  





 This role is suited for someone who can operate both strategically and hands\-on when needed, but whose main strength is building systems, teams, ownership models, and engineering discipline that do not depend on a single individual.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and platform operations.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, observability, and incident readiness across critical systems.
* Support the company’s cybersecurity posture across ISIEM, SOC, DLP, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat modelling, monitoring, incident response, and security awareness.
* Lead the practical adoption of Agentic AI across engineering and technology operations.
* Strengthen security, compliance, audit readiness, access controls, data protection, and secure SDLC practices.
* Build and mature NOC/SOC capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, escalation, and post\-incident reviews.
* Scale the platform and the technical team for geographical expansion, including multi\-market readiness, localisation needs, regulatory expectations, and infrastructure scalability.
* Manage technical relationships with third\-party providers of core services, including issuing processors, payment providers, banking partners, cloud vendors, security vendors, and integration platforms.
* Improve ownership models, documentation, Runbooks, SLAs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and help build a reliable leadership structure across engineering and operations.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 10\+ years Senior technology leadership experience in a roles VP Engineering/ Technology, Head of Engineering/Technology, or similar.
* Experience in fintech, specifically issuing, acquiring or banking is essential.
* Proven track record scaling reliable, secure, compliant production systems.
* Proven track record of the Agentic AI adaptation and productivity gain.
* Experience building engineering teams, technical operations, NOC/SOC processes, and delivery discipline.
* Experience with either ISO27001, SAMA, SOC2 and PCI DSS regulatory implementation and support.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, backend platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, disaster recovery and incident management.
* Experience working with third\-party providers of mission\-critical services.
* Ability to operate across strategy, architecture, execution, people leadership, and executive communication.

**Project Manager – ONESOURCE**

 is a leading provider of transaction tax management solutions to companies of all sizes, enabling Finance, Tax and IT professionals to achieve accurate, timely and cost\-effective compliance.  We are now hiring an
 **ONESOURCE Technology Implementation \& Consulting Project Manager** 
 to lead the delivery of software implementation projects within the Indirect Tax consulting organization. You will work closely with project teams, peer project managers, sales, customer service, clients, and partner consulting teams.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager,** 
 you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Service Delivery \& Portfolio Management

* Travel

**About You**
 To be our
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager** 
 , you will likely have:

**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.

**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

* Communications \& Telecoms

* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.

* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.

* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**

* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.

* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  

 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  

 Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  

 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  





 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a strong Commercial Director to join our growing infrastructure team in the UAE.
   

  





 In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction to the team on major programmes, with a strong focus on post\-contract delivery and driving commercial success. You will also embed and promote the values of Turner \& Townsend.
   

  





 The successful candidate will be an agile and emotionally intelligent leader with a strong track record in technical delivery of major programmes. International and cross\-sector experience with an ability to work in multi\-cultural environments is beneficial. The successful candidate will be a cost management generalist, covering estimating, cost, scheduling, risk, change, performance measurement and reporting, with demonstrated expertise in major delivery programmes. They should operate at a senior level and be comfortable presenting to large groups and senior\-level client bases.
   

  





 Key responsibilities:
   

  




* Act as principal point of contact for cost management matters and lead the Turner \& Townsend team.
* Leads and motivates others to participate and contribute, provides necessary direction and inspires high performance.
* Take on key account role(s), project execution assurance and maintain client relationships as required.
* Deliver assurance services to projects \- peer review, gateway review, maturity assessments, readiness reviews, progress and performance audits.
* Periodically take on major program delivery roles and lead the Turner \& Townsend team on the commission \- achieve a successful "steady state" delivery and then manage transition and backfill.
* Provide oversight and assurance to the Turner \& Townsend major program in the region.
* Identify organizational needs, build recruitment plans and develop role specifications.
* Extensive experience in delivering CM programs, projects and segment knowledge.
* Play a key role in the infrastructure business development activities for the cost center.
* Assist in the development and implementation of marketing and business development strategies.
* Provide solutions to clients and work together with business development team members on sales proposals, qualification packages and presentation materials.
* Coordinate with project team leaders on project negotiations and execution.
* Collaborate with the other business divisions and teams.
* Provide oversight and assurance to the Turner \& Townsend major programs in the region.
* Delivers high quality of service products by utilizing Turner \& Townsend systems, policy and procedure, managing time, planning and organizing to ensure excellence.
* Demonstrates understanding of commercial business drivers and ensures that work and projects are carried out in alignment. Contributes to the development of business opportunities.
* Demonstrable appetite for challenge, innovation and continued improvement in CM discipline.
* Take responsibility for BU performance and project P/L
* Identify and understand the areas of opportunity and development.
* Enable continued growth trajectory within the market.
* Be a developer of talent and enjoy coaching early/mid\-career cost management staff to meet their own and our business goals.
* Be comfortable working with remote staff across global time zones.
* Be organized and strong administratively.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 20 years of relevant experience
* Degree in Quantity Surveying or related field
* MRICS qualified (FRICS is a plus)
* Strong leadership and team management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Experience in developing and mentoring teams

Amali Properties is a luxury real estate developer co\-founded by Mr. Ali Sajwani and Ms. Amira Sajwani, redefining modern luxury living through bespoke architecture, visionary design, and exceptional craftsmanship.
 



  





 With a growing portfolio of ultra\-luxury developments across the UAE, Amali is shaping the future of refined living through distinctive, design\-led spaces that blend privacy, sophistication, and innovation.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a highly accomplished Director to Design lead and oversee the design management and technical coordination of construction and development projects, ensuring the effective delivery of design solutions that meet project objectives, quality standards, budget requirements, and schedule commitments. The role provides technical expertise and guidance throughout the design lifecycle, drives collaboration among internal stakeholders and external consultants, and ensures compliance with local regulations, company standards, and industry best practices. The Director Design is responsible for managing multidisciplinary design teams, facilitating design integration, mitigating design\-related risks, and supporting the successful translation of project vision into deliverable, buildable, and commercially viable outcomes.
 



  




* Lead and oversee the design management process from concept to completion across multiple ultra\-luxury developments.
* Review and critique architectural and interior design submissions to ensure alignment with Amali’s brand vision and design standards.
* Manage and coordinate the work of international and local design consultants, ensuring seamless collaboration and delivery.
* Drive innovation and creativity, balancing aesthetics, functionality, and luxury in every design decision.
* Ensure full design compliance with regulatory authorities, project timelines, and budgetary goals.
* Conduct regular design review meetings, monitor progress, and resolve design\-related issues efficiently.
* Collaborate with project, engineering, and construction teams to ensure design intent is fully realized on\-site.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of luxury design trends, materials, and technologies to continually elevate design quality.



  





**Experience \& Skills** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture or Design Management.
* 12\+ years of experience in architectural design and project delivery, with a strong portfolio in ultra\-luxury residential or Mansions or Royal palace projects.
* Proven ability to manage and lead international design consultants and multidisciplinary teams.
* Expertise in design coordination, technical reviews, and luxury detailing.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills with a strong eye for design quality.
* Deep understanding of architecture, interiors, and landscape integration in high\-end development.

Role Type: Contractor
 



 Term: 4 to 6 months
 



 Location: Remote – Time Zone GMT/UTC\+4 (Dubai)
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of a complex consent management implementation. This role will be responsible for ensuring seamless integration across multiple systems, aligning technical workstreams, and driving delivery across a highly distributed ecosystem.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of coordinating across product, engineering, architecture, and third\-party vendors to ensure successful implementation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical Delivery Ownership** 




 • Own and drive end\-to\-end delivery for all consent management\-related workstreams
 



 • Translate requirements:
 


* Defined work packages
* Delivery milestones
* System\-level deliverables



 • Ensure alignment across:
 


* Consent Management configuration
* MuleSoft APIs and event layers
* Source systems
* Downstream systems



**2\. Integration Orchestration** 




 • Act as the primary coordinator for all integrations
 



 • Define and drive clarity on:
 


* Event contracts
* Data payload structures
* End\-to\-end data flow



 • Proactively identify and resolve:
 


* Missing or incomplete data fields
* Identity resolution gaps
* System incompatibilities and assumptions



**3\. Workshop \& Design Facilitation** 




 • Co\-lead technical workshops with:
 


* Product (WMI)
* Architecture
* Engineering teams
* External vendors



 • Translate discussions into:
 


* Clear technical decisions
* Documented workflows and architecture
* Actionable next steps



**4\. Consent Management Configuration Ownership** 




 • Translate business and product requirements into:
 


* Consent management platform data model configuration
* Consent category setup
* Channel\-level consent mapping
* Policy enforcement rules



**5\. Dependency \& Risk Management** 




 • Identify and manage cross\-system dependencies early:
 


* Source systems
* Identity management challenges
* Compliance dependencies (e.g., industry consent requirements)



 • Maintain:
 


* Risk log
* Dependency tracker
* Decision log



**6\. Testing \& Production Readiness** 




 • Define and track:
 


* Integration testing scenarios
* UAT scenarios per source system
* Consent propagation validation processes



 • Ensure:
 


* Audit trails are complete and verifiable
* Edge cases are fully covered



**7\. Cross\-Vendor Coordination** 




 • Serve as the single point of coordination for consent management platform\-related delivery across all source and downstream systems.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Proven experience as a Technical Project Manager in complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of:
* API integrations and event\-driven architectures
* Middleware platforms (preferably MuleSoft)
* Data flow design and system integration patterns
* Experience working with consent management platforms or regulated data environments
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Strong stakeholder management across multiple teams and vendors
* Excellent facilitation and communication skills



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Proactive and delivery\-focused mindset
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ability to challenge unclear requirements and drive clarity
* Skilled in identifying risks and resolving integration gaps early
* Comfortable working in complex, multi\-system ecosystems



  





**Success Profile** 




 This role requires someone who:
 


* Identifies integration and design gaps early
* Drives alignment across cross\-functional teams
* Ensures the consent management platform implementation is fully embedded within the broader enterprise architecture
* Delivers outcomes, not just coordination

data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.

This role sits within a broader enterprise transformation initiative and is responsible for managing a dedicated workstream supporting the migration of operational capabilities from legacy platforms to a modern enterprise solution. The Project Manager will work closely with operational and technical teams to coordinate activities, manage dependencies, and support the successful delivery of the wider program objectives.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be comfortable operating within a multi\-stream environment, collaborating with parallel project teams and external vendors while ensuring that operational requirements are effectively represented throughout the delivery lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for a Project Manager with experience in enterprise system migrations and operational transformation who enjoys working at the intersection of business operations and technology delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Workstream Project Management
   

  

* Manage a dedicated workstream within a larger transformation program.
* Coordinate the migration of operational functions from legacy systems into a unified enterprise platform.
* Support project planning, governance, status reporting, risk tracking, and dependency management across the assigned workstream.
* Collaborate with adjacent workstreams to ensure delivery activities remain aligned with the overall program roadmap.
* Facilitate the successful transition of users, processes, and operational capabilities onto the target platform.


 Operations Transformation
   

  

* Support the migration of key operational functions, including:
+ Helpline Services
+ Pre\-certification Processes
+ Claims Processing
+ Direct Billing
+ Reimbursement
+ Policy Administration
+ International Health Insurance operational processes

* Ensure operational requirements are clearly understood and reflected throughout project delivery.
* Support the adoption of new processes and ways of working while maintaining business continuity.


 Business \& Technology Coordination
   

  

* Act as a key link between operational teams and technology delivery teams.
* Work closely with technical specialists responsible for data integration, reporting, platform enhancements, and vendor\-delivered solutions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs and help manage dependencies across multiple workstreams.
* Support the alignment of business needs with technical delivery activities.


 Defect \& Issue Management
   

  

* Coordinate defect and issue management activities across the workstream.
* Ensure operational requirements are represented during testing and validation activities.
* Support the tracking, prioritization, and resolution of system and process issues.
* Help ensure that system performance and usability align with operational expectations.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Build effective working relationships with operational teams, business users, technical delivery teams, and external partners.
* Facilitate workshops, project meetings, and regular progress updates.
* Ensure communication remains clear across all functions involved in the transformation program.
* Support collaboration across parallel initiatives and vendor\-delivered components.


 Key Requirements
   

  

* Proven experience as a Project Manager supporting business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience working on enterprise platform migrations or legacy system modernization programs.
* Strong understanding of operational process transformation.
* Experience working within multi\-stream programs with complex dependencies.
* Ability to coordinate activities across business and technology teams.
* Experience with project governance, reporting, risk management, and dependency tracking.
* Experience supporting testing, operational readiness, and transition activities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience within the insurance or financial services sector.
* Exposure to health insurance operations, claims processing, policy administration, billing, or reimbursement functions.
* Experience working within large international organizations or consulting environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

 Golden Square Engineering Consultants (GS), founded in 2001, is a leading multi\-disciplinary planning and design firm offering innovative architectural and engineering consulting services in the UAE and the MENA region. Dedicated to sustainable, energy\-efficient green building solutions, GS collaborates with clients and contractors across public and private sectors to deliver high\-quality projects on time and within budget. With offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, Baghdad, and Canada, GS specializes in designing landmark industrial, residential, commercial, and institutional facilities. Known for its client\-focused approach, the firm provides integrated consulting services, emphasizing integrity, excellence, and value creation in every project.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Senior Interior Designer
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
 



**Department:** 
 Interior Design
 



**Reports To:** 
 Design Director / Head of Design
 




 § 
 
**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly creative and technically proficient Senior Interior Designer to join our multidisciplinary architectural consultancy team in Dubai. The successful candidate will lead interior design projects from concept development through detailed design and tender documentation stages, ensuring exceptional design quality, technical accuracy, and compliance with local regulations and international standards.
 



 The ideal candidate will possess strong design leadership skills, extensive consultancy experience, and a proven track record in delivering residential, hospitality, commercial, mixed\-use, and high\-end projects within the UAE and GCC region.
 




 § 
 
**Key Responsibilities** 




**Concept Design \& Design Development** 




 v Lead the development of innovative and creative interior design concepts aligned with client objectives, project requirements, and brand standards.
 



 v Prepare concept presentations, mood boards, material palettes, space planning layouts, and design narratives.
 



 v Develop schematic and design development packages, ensuring consistency of design intent throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 v Conduct client presentations and workshops, effectively communicating design concepts and recommendations.
 



 v Collaborate closely with architects, landscape designers, and engineering disciplines to ensure integrated design solutions.
 



**Detailed Design** 




 v Produce and oversee detailed interior design drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, bespoke joinery details, and construction details.
 



 v Prepare material specifications, finish schedules, FF\&E schedules, and technical documentation.
 



 v Ensure compliance with Dubai Municipality requirements, local authority regulations, building codes, accessibility standards, and project\-specific guidelines.
 



 v Coordinate design deliverables with architectural, structural, MEP, and specialist consultants.
 



 v Review and resolve technical design challenges while maintaining design integrity.
 



**Tender Documentation** 




 v Lead the preparation of comprehensive tender packages, including detailed drawings, specifications, schedules, and scope documentation.
 



 v Assist in preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and technical specifications.
 



 v Review contractor queries during tender stages and provide technical clarifications.
 



 v Evaluate contractor submissions, shop drawings, material submittals, and value engineering proposals.
 



 v Support procurement and contractor selection processes from a design and technical perspective.
 



**Project Coordination \& Delivery** 




 v Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, programme, and budget objectives.
 



 v Attend client meetings, consultant coordination meetings, and design review workshops.
 



 v Conduct site visits during construction stages to ensure compliance with design intent and specifications.
 



 v Review mock\-ups, samples, and material submissions.
 



 v Support project managers in monitoring project progress and resolving design\-related issues.
 



**Qualifications** 




 v Bachelor’s Degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, or related field.
 



 v Minimum 12 years of professional experience in interior design consultancy.
 



 v Minimum 6 years of UAE/GCC project experience, preferably within a reputable architectural or multidisciplinary consultancy.
 



 v Demonstrated experience in concept design, design development, detailed design, and tender documentation.
 



 v Strong portfolio showcasing high\-quality residential, hospitality, commercial, mixed\-use, and luxury projects.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 v Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit.
 



 v Strong knowledge of BIM workflows and project coordination.
 



 v Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
 



 v Experience with SketchUp, Enscape, Lumion, 3ds Max, or similar visualization software.
 



 v Strong understanding of construction methodologies, detailing, materials, and specifications.
 



 v Knowledge of Dubai Municipality regulations, UAE building codes, and authority approval processes.
 



**Competencies** 




 v Excellent design, presentation, and visualization skills.
 



 v Strong technical detailing and documentation capabilities.
 



 v Exceptional communication and client\-facing skills.
 



 v Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects simultaneously.
 



 v Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management skills.
 



 v Commercial awareness and problem\-solving ability.
 


* v High attention to detail and commitment to design excellence.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions


**Responsibilities**
* Expertise in electrical modelling and analysis software (ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, CDEGS, or similar)
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (Navisworks, AutoCAD, single\-line diagram tools)
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks and certifications (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) as they apply to data centres
* Experience with and understanding of the selection of electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities
* Familiarity with industry design standards and specifications (Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ISO standards for data centres)
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) certification preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency strategies, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewable energy integration in data centres
* Experience with utility (DEWA, TAQA, SEC) coordination, power infrastructure planning, and large load interconnection processes with regional utilities
* Knowledge of data centre monitoring and control systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS integration)
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project economics, risk management, and value engineering
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

data.jd_text:
Job Purpose:
 



 Lead complex assurance and advisory engagements at Dubai Health, emphasizing healthcare\-specific risks, regulatory compliance and strategic risk management. Provide expert insights to shape departmental audit planning and strategy, including annual risk assessments and innovative methodologies. Mentor audit team members and develop strategies to enhance governance, operational efficiency, and compliance in healthcare settings. Guide staff on best practices in healthcare auditing, advanced risk identification, data analytics, and emerging industry trends.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



1. Lead and manage high\-complexity assurance and advisory assignments, delivering expert risk insights to inform and refine the department’s annual assurance planning and strategic priorities.
2. Collaborate with the Section Head and Director to conduct enterprise\-wide risk assessments, develop risk\-based audit strategies, and prioritize audit coverage.
3. Independently oversee audit fieldwork execution, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, quality standards and timely delivery while mentoring team members on advanced techniques.
4. Design, implement and continuously refine internal audit policies, procedures and methodologies, incorporating innovative tools like AI\-driven analytics to support long\-term audit function strategy and resource optimization.
5. Analyze audit findings, trends and key performance indicators to identify systemic risks, recommend enhancements to clinical documentation, risk mitigation frameworks and overall governance structures.
6. Develop and deliver targeted training programs for audit staff, cross\-functional teams and stakeholders on compliance standards, healthcare audit best practices and strategic risk management.
7. Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory bodies and senior leadership to address audit findings, influence policy changes and contribute to organizational compliance strategies.
8. Evaluate and test controls through data collection, validation and analysis to assess risk exposure and control effectiveness, identifying opportunities for business process improvements.
9. Determine and apply optimal audit approaches, techniques and procedures to form objective opinions on control environments and strategic alignment.
10. Present comprehensive findings, recommendations and strategic insights to senior management, influencing decision\-making and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
11. Partner with business, IT and clinical stakeholders to co\-develop practical, sustainable actions that mitigate identified risks and align with Dubai Health’s strategic goals.
12. Draft detailed audit reports, track management responses and verify implementation of agreed actions to ensure accountability and strategic outcomes.
13. Contribute to periodic monitoring of Dubai Health’s risk profile, advising on emerging healthcare risks (e.g., cybersecurity in patient data, supply chain disruptions) to shape future audit strategies.
14. Promote 'smarter' assurance practices, such as predictive analytics and automation, to enhance audit efficiency and strategic value.
15. Maintain thorough documentation of audit work in line with IIA standards and departmental protocols, supporting knowledge sharing and strategic reviews.
16. Coach, mentor, and guide Internal Audit staff (including Seniors and Associates) on industry\-leading practices, risk identification, data analytics, and strategic thinking in healthcare auditing.



  





**Qualification Requirements:** 




 Bachelor \- Accounting or a related field
 



 Certification \- Chartered Accountant / CPA / CIA (Exception for UAE national)
 



  





**Years of Experience:** 




 8 (Exception for UAE National) \- Auditing / risk management or equivalent exposure in jobs involving process reviews and reviews of management information in Finance / other departments
 



 2\-3 (Exception for UAE National) \- Healthcare sector

data.jd_text:
**Some brands sell products.** 




**We help shape decisions that change lives.** 




  





 Every day, 24 million measurements are taken on a seca device somewhere in the world. In hospitals in Tokyo, clinics in São Paulo, GP practices in Hamburg. The data that flows from those moments helps doctors, nurses, and specialists make decisions that matter — sometimes routine, sometimes life\-changing.
 



  





 We are not a tech startup. We are not a challenger brand reinventing ourselves every 18 months. We are a 185\-year\-old family business with the discipline of a world market leader, the curiosity of engineers who still love what they build, and a marketing team that thinks in campaigns — not content calendars.
 



  





**And we have one open seat.** 




  





**What this role actually is:** 




 As
 **Senior Creative \- Campaign Art Direction (m/f/d)** 
 you will be a central creative force behind our international campaigns across Medical and Fitness — two demanding, visually distinct segments, both requiring the kind of strategic depth and executional craft that only comes from real agency experience.
 



  





 This is not a production role. This is not a "make it beautiful" role. This is a thinking\-and\-making role, where concept and execution are inseparable and where the quality of the idea is just as accountable as the quality of the layout.
 



  





 You will join an international team at our
 **office in Dubai, UAE** 
 and work closely with our Global Marketing and Creative teams at our headquarters in Hamburg, Germany inside our inhouse creative studio — structured and resourced like an agency, embedded in one of the most internationally active Health Tech companies in the world. Working closely with and under the creative direction of our Head of Creative, you will develop campaigns from brief to delivery across digital\-first formats: landing pages, paid social, display, video, and interactive platforms. You bring the craft, the concept discipline, and the drive to see an idea through without needing someone to push it. What you do not bring is the ego of someone who needs to run the room.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for:** 



* Developing campaign concepts from strategic brief to final execution — under creative direction, but with genuine ownership of your work
* Executing the visual language of integrated campaigns across digital, social, and where relevant, linear formats including trade fair and print
* Creating and art directing digital experiences: landing pages, UI concepts, interactive campaign formats
* Maintaining creative quality across global rollouts adapted for up to 16 international markets and languages
* Collaborating directly with Marketing and Product Management, with the professionalism to represent the creative work clearly and confidently



  





**What you bring:** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in advertising or brand communications, with a substantial part of that in an agency environment
* A portfolio that demonstrates both conceptual strength and executional mastery — campaigns you conceived and built, not just approved
* Deep expertise in Figma and Adobe CC; you work in the tools, not around them
* Proven experience in digital campaign production: landing pages, paid social, motion graphics
* Experience in Medical, Health Tech, or Fitness marketing is a significant advantage — you understand that this audience demands precision, not flair for its own sake
* Fluent English, written and spoken — our campaigns are global, our briefs are often in English, and your presentations will be too
* Linear advertising experience (TV, OOH, AV) is a bonus, not a barrier
* The maturity to thrive within a defined creative direction while still bringing your own strong point of view to every brief



  





**What we offer:** 




 We will skip the part about the coffee and the fruit basket. You have read that before. What we can offer that most can not: the creative ambition of an agency environment, inside a company with genuine market authority, a 185\-year legacy that is not a limitation but a creative challenge, and a product portfolio that genuinely affects human health. Your work will reach healthcare professionals across 17 international branches and over 175,000 customers worldwide.
 



  





 Join a workplace that connects, motivates, and moves forward together – where your work has real impact.
 



  





**About seca** 




 Founded in Hamburg in 1840, seca has grown from a precision scale workshop into a global Health Tech brand. For over 185 years, we have built devices and software solutions that help healthcare professionals make better decisions — in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and fitness facilities around the world. As a family\-owned company now in its fourth generation, we operate 17 international branches.
 



  





**Ready to shape international campaigns for a global Health Tech brand?** 
 Apply today and help define how seca communicates across Medical, Fitness, and digital platforms. We look forward to receiving your complete application. Please note that only applications including a relevant portfolio or selected work samples will be considered.
