data.jd_text:
Desert River Event Rentals is one of the UAE's leading event rental companies, supplying premium furniture, lighting and décor to exhibitions, conferences, corporate events, hospitality venues and brand experiences across the region.
 



 Our reputation is built on reliability, attention to detail and exceptional service. Behind every successful event is a strong operations team, and we are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead, develop and continuously improve ours.
 



 This role reports directly to the Head of Event Rentals and plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth delivery of projects across warehouse operations, logistics, transportation and on\-site event execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Operational Leadership** 



* Lead, coach and develop the operations team across warehouse, logistics and event delivery
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, professionalism and continuous improvement
* Set clear expectations, monitor performance and support team development
* Recruit, train and onboard operational team members as the business grows



  





**Event Delivery \& Logistics** 



* Plan and oversee the successful delivery, installation and collection of rental equipment across multiple projects and venues
* Coordinate staff schedules, vehicle allocation and operational resources to ensure efficient execution
* Manage on\-site operations and provide leadership during installations, event periods and dismantles
* Act as the primary operational decision\-maker when challenges arise and ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally



  





**Warehouse \& Inventory Management** 



* Oversee warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, maintenance processes and quality control standards
* Ensure rental assets are maintained, repaired and presented to the highest standard
* Continuously improve operational workflows, systems and procedures to increase efficiency and scalability
* Work closely with procurement, suppliers and transport partners to ensure reliable operational support



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure all operations are conducted in accordance with company policies, venue requirements and industry best practices
* Maintain strong standards around health and safety, risk management, security procedures and operational compliance
* Ensure teams are properly briefed and equipped to work safely and professionally at all times
* Maintain awareness of venue regulations, access requirements and event\-specific operational procedures



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with the Sales team to ensure client expectations are translated into successful operational delivery
* Build strong working relationships with clients, venues, contractors and suppliers
* Contribute operational insight and recommendations that improve both customer experience and business performance



  





**About You** 




 You are a confident and approachable operational leader who enjoys working alongside your team and takes pride in delivering outstanding results. You combine strong organisational skills with practical problem\-solving ability and remain calm and decisive in fast\-paced environments.
 



 You will ideally have:
 


* A minimum of 3–5 years' experience in an operational leadership or management role within event rentals, event production, exhibitions, logistics or a related industry
* Proven experience leading, developing and managing operational teams
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, logistics planning and project execution
* Practical understanding of event operations, venue requirements, health and safety procedures, security protocols and risk management
* Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high operational standards
* Excellent organisational, communication and leadership skills
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented approach with strong attention to detail
* The ability to build trust and credibility with colleagues, clients and partners
* A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively within multicultural teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the importance of customer satisfaction, efficiency and profitability



  





**Requirements** 



* Based in the UAE
* Valid UAE manual driving licence
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken
* Flexible regarding working hours and event schedules
* Strong Microsoft Office skills
* Event industry experience strongly preferred



  





**Our Culture** 




 At Desert River, we believe exceptional events are created by exceptional people working together. We value teamwork, integrity, initiative, respect and continuous improvement. We support each other, take ownership of our responsibilities and celebrate success as a team.
 



 We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 We offer the opportunity to play a key role in one of the UAE's leading event rental businesses, working on a diverse range of projects for some of the region's most recognised brands, venues and events.
 



 In addition, we offer:
 


* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Five\-day working week
* UAE employment visa sponsorship
* Annual flight allowance
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development
* A collaborative, creative and supportive working environment

Operating in 100 countries with 19,500 employees, Egis delivers innovative solutions that support balanced territorial development and improve quality of life for communities around the globe.
   

  





 In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across eight countries and has successfully delivered more than 700 complex development projects. Recognised among the region's leading engineering and consulting firms, Egis combines global expertise with deep local knowledge to support governments, investors, and developers in delivering sustainable growth and lasting positive impact.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Represent WW\+P in the region, utilising a comprehensive knowledge of the WW\+P project portfolio, values, and approach.
* Collaborate with the WW\+P global studio, primarily through liaison with the Middle East Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team.
* Collaborate with the 10N Collective to maximise working synergies and support regional growth.
* Collaborate with all relevant Egis Business Lines and Units to maximise working synergies and support growth. Close working relationships with relevant colleagues in Transportation, Energy \& Sustainable Cites, and Aviation will be important to the success of the role.

* Be a champion of a user\-centric design philosophy, demonstrating empathy with end\-users and creating projects that resonate with their needs and desires.
* Safeguard and evolve the identity of WW\+P, ensuring output aligns with the brand's values and messaging.
* Support and mine new business opportunities: advance the client’s knowledge of core capabilities; recognize untapped opportunities within existing relationships; leverage formal and informal networks in the pursuit of new business possibilities.
* Maximise project profit returns where possible.


**Qualifications**
* Proven track record of delivering excellent, award\-winning design on a variety of project typologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and present design concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the Middle East construction market, including the relevant local and international clients, consultants, contractors and stakeholders.
* Leadership experience including the ability to communicate with and manage remote design teams.
* Strong commercial understanding and project management.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and successful implementations.

**Company Description** 
 MARE Properties L.L.C. is a Dubai\-based real estate firm specializing in exclusive developments and premium investment opportunities. The company represents projects that help shape the city’s future skyline and lifestyle offerings. Driven by integrity, innovation, and measurable results, MARE Properties focuses on long\-term value creation for clients and partners. The role will direct and support sales teams, set performance targets, and drive execution plans to maximize revenue and profitability. * Demonstrated Team Management skills, with experience leading, mentoring, and developing high\-performing commercial or sales teams.
* Extensive experience in contract negotiation, deal structuring, and stakeholder management with investors, developers, and strategic partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Real Estate, or a related field; a relevant master’s degree or professional certification is an advantage.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions at executive and board levels.
* Deep understanding of the Dubai real estate market, regulatory environment, and investment landscape, or the ability to quickly acquire this knowledge.
* High level of integrity, strategic thinking, and results orientation, with the capacity to work in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.

 The business operates a flagship 30\-bed residential site and has recently expanded into Europe with a specialist 10\-bed programme — reflecting an ambitious international growth agenda under the leadership of a highly experienced CEO with a background in world\-class medical tourism operations.
 



  





 The model is built on medical tourism: clients travel from the UK, Australia, the Middle East, Singapore, the Netherlands, the US, and Canada to access a programme that delivers demonstrably better outcomes at approximately 40% of the cost of comparable UK providers — with private rooms, comprehensive clinical programming, and a destination environment that facilitates genuine recovery.
 



  





 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. Your role is to lead, elevate, and execute — bringing strategic rigour, digital expertise, and commercial edge to a business that has earned its reputation through exceptional clinical outcomes and now needs to accelerate its market presence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and deliver revenue performance across all markets and service lines
* Lead the Admissions function to ensure a seamless, high\-conversion client journey
* Expand the international referral network — outpatient centres, clinicians, concierge providers, and wellness operators
* Develop targeted growth strategies across the UK, Australia, Asia, Middle East, and US
* Represent the organisation at international forums and industry events



  





**Marketing \& Digital Acquisition** 



* Lead the internal marketing team and external agency partners
* Drive performance across online search, AI\-driven discovery platforms, SEO, and digital channels
* Own the content strategy across all pillars: search, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and thought leadership
* Improve visibility on AI discovery platforms where the business is currently underrepresented
* Maintain rigorous oversight of ROI, attribution, and brand integrity



  





**Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care
* Lead content creation that reflects the business's evolution toward holistic, nervous system\-informed, mental health\-integrated approaches
* Ensure a consistent, premium brand voice across all touchpoints and markets
* Strengthen trust through PR, media, strategic partnerships, and expert positioning



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 The successful candidate will be hands\-on, hungry, and commercially sharp — someone who leads by doing, not just by directing. You will be as comfortable shaping content strategy as you are reviewing conversion data or meeting a clinical referral partner.
 



  





**You will bring:** 



* Demonstrable experience leading Sales and/or Marketing functions at Director level in a healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or international services environment
* Deep expertise in digital marketing — particularly SEO, AI\-driven discovery, content strategy, and omnichannel acquisition
* Proven track record working with and holding external agency partners accountable
* Experience serving or acquiring high\-net\-worth, international, or premium client bases
* Strong people leadership — able to develop and motivate a small, technically skilled team
* Exceptional written English — essential for content oversight and brand governance given a non\-native English speaking team
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to work sensitively within a healthcare environment that includes staff and clients in recovery
* The ability to read and align to a brand's heritage, tone, and values — and build strategically from that foundation



  





**Highly desirable:** 



* Background in addiction treatment, mental health, or international patient services
* Lived recovery experience — genuinely valued, not required
* Prior experience living or working in Asia, or demonstrable international living experience
* Familiarity with medical tourism as a business model and client acquisition channel



  





**The Package \& Location** 




  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Base salary: \~$100,000 USD per annum
* 25 days combined annual leave
* Relocation flights to Thailand covered
* Temporary housing provided on arrival (2–4 weeks)
* Visa sponsorship and application support provided
* Results\-focused role — effectiveness prioritised over hours



**Why Chiang Mai?** 



* Low cost of living — $100k USD goes significantly further than UK equivalent
* Lower Thai income tax rates — take\-home substantially higher than UK
* Vibrant international expat community and thriving lifestyle
* World\-class food, culture, and outdoor environment
* Direct flights to Bangkok (1 hour, multiple daily); Bangkok is 12 hours from London



  





  





**To Apply** 




  





 To be considered for this role, in the first instance contact scousins@compassltd.co.uk with a detailed CV. Please note we will only consider candidates with direct experience of driving referrals from an international patient/customer base

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.

With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director Digital UI/UX is accountable for defining and leading Kerzner International’s digital experience strategy and design execution across the global brand portfolio, including Atlantis, One\&Only, SIRO, and Rare Finds.
   

  

 The role owns the end\-to\-end experience, vision, design quality, and user ‑centred execution across all digital products and channels, ensuring guest journeys are intuitive, premium, accessible, and conversion effective. Acting as the design authority for digital experience, the Director‑ Digital UI/UX establishes experience principles, design systems, and optimisation practices that consistently translate brand intent into high q‑uality digital interactions.
   

  

 The Director Digital UI/UX works in close partnership with the Director Digital Products, who owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, and platform decisions. Together, the roles ensure digital products deliver measurable business results while maintaining a differentiated, guest centric experience aligned with Kerzner’s luxury positioning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Experience Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and own Kerzner’s global digital experience strategy across web, mobile, booking, and supporting platforms
* Translate brand, guest, and business objectives into clear experience principles and design direction
* Ensure consistency of experience across brands while allowing for brand specific expression where required
* Act as the senior design authority for all guest facing digital experience


**Guest Journey Design \& Optimisation**
* Lead the design of end\-to\-end guest journeys across discovery, inspiration, booking, and post booking touchpoints
* Drive continuous experience optimisation to improve usability, engagement, and conversion
* Partner with the Director Digital Products to align experience led optimisation initiatives with commercial priorities and targets
* Balance ‑guest centric design with performance, scalability, and delivery constraints


**Design Systems, Standards \& Governance**
* Establish, evolve, and govern Kerzner’s digital design systems, component libraries, and experience standards
* Define UX/UI best practices, accessibility standards, and quality benchmarks
* Ensure consistent application of design standards across internal teams, agencies, and partners
* Review and approve experience and design decisions for major initiatives and releases
* Maintain hands‑on proficiency in industry‑standard tools (e.g. Figma) and emerging AI‑powered design capabilities


**User Research, Insights \& Experimentation**
* Own user research practices, including qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, and journey validation
* Interpret analytics, experimentation results, and guest feedback to identify experience improvement opportunities
* Translate insights into actionable design recommendations and priorities
* Collaborate with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to ensure insights inform roadmap and optimisation decisions


**Cross Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Partner closely with Digital Products, Technology, Marketing, Brand, and Content teams
* Support agile and product oriented delivery models with embedded design practices
* Provide clear executive level communication on experience vision, priorities, and outcomes
* Engage and manage external design agencies and partners to deliver against experience standards


**Ways of Working**
 The Director Digital UI/UX and Director Digital Products operate as peer leaders within the Digital \& Technology leadership team. The Director Digital UI/UX owns experience strategy, design quality, and user ‑centred execution, while the Director Digital Products owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, platform strategy, and technical decision making. Decisions impacting both domains are made collaboratively, with escalation to the Chief Digital \& Information Officer where required‑.
   

  

**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 10\+ years’ experience in UX/UI, digital experience design, or customer experience roles
* 5\+ years’ experience leading design teams in complex, global digital environments
* Experience in hospitality, luxury, travel, or consumer facing digital platforms preferred


**Design \& Experience Expertise**
* Deep expertise in UX/UI design, interaction design, and experience strategy
* Strong experience designing for complex ecosystems including content, commerce, and booking journeys
* Proven track record of improving conversion and engagement through experience led design
* Strong understanding of accessibility, usability standards, and inclusive design


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

 . data.jd_text:
HKA is a leading global consultancy in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, expert witness and litigation support. We anticipate, investigate and resolve complex challenges by harnessing world\-leading multi\-disciplinary expertise and experience.
   

  

 As trusted independent consultants, experts and advisors, we deliver solutions amid uncertainty, dispute and overrun, and provide the insights that make the best possible outcomes a reality for public and private sector clients worldwide. Our experts have testified across the globe on many of the largest quantum, delay, engineering and commercial damages matters.
   

  

**At HKA, You Can Expect**
* A genuinely collaborative culture where we invest in growing our FACD practice and your career together.
* A pivotal role in shaping the future of our FACD offering across EMEA and globally.
* The opportunity to leverage HKA’s reputation as one of the world’s most respected expert witness firms to accelerate the growth of your valuation and financial damages portfolio.
* Access to an outstanding expert platform, cutting\-edge methodologies and a global network of specialists.


**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Manager / Associate Director in our Forensic Accounting \& Commercial Damages (FACD) team, you’ll be part of a high‑performing global practice known for delivering market‑leading expert advisory services.
   

  

 This is an exciting stage for our Middle East team, offering the chance to step into a visible leadership role, working alongside Partners recognised internationally for their expertise in contentious valuations and forensic accounting.
   

  

**You will play a key role in the success and continued expansion of our International FACD practice by:**
* Leading substantial workstreams on complex disputes and managing smaller engagements end‑to‑end.
* Owning key client relationships and ensuring exceptional delivery.
* Guiding, coaching and developing junior colleagues as part of a growing team.
* Drafting articulate, concise and compelling expert reports, supporting our experts on high‑value disputes.
* Conducting and reviewing sophisticated financial, accounting and economic analyses with a high degree of technical rigour.
* Performing business valuations, using relevant tools and methodologies to generate robust and defensible opinions.
* Communicating insights and deliverables clearly to Partners, clients and legal teams.
* Driving business development, including attending industry events, identifying opportunities and contributing to thought leadership.
* Leading internal development initiatives, from training to process improvement.


**Skills \& Experience**
 We’re looking for an ambitious, analytical and commercially sharp Senior Manager / Associate Director who brings:
   

  

* A graduate or postgraduate degree in accounting, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Qualified accountant status (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with experience in a recognised professional services environment specifically within forensics.
* Demonstrated experience in forensic accounting, contentious valuations, and dispute\-related engagements.
* Strong problem‑solving skills, exceptional analytical capability and meticulous attention to detail.
* The ability to think strategically and operate confidently in ambiguous or evolving situations.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly.
* A reputation as a trusted colleague and collaborative team member.
* Fluency in English is essential; additional language capability is advantageous but not required.

 All HKA employment decisions are firstly made on merit and shall be made without regard to age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, marriage, and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation, or any other basis in compliance with local legislation.

If you would like more confirmation, please feel free to email us at enquiries@hka.com to check the authenticity of a job posting.

 .

 Reports to:

 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts

**City Physical Security Systems**

**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**

data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Executive Director \- MMC \& Delivery Learning Systems is responsible for institutionalising innovation and structured learning across the Qiddiya City Programme.
   

  

 The role leads two strategic programme enablers:
   

  

* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) \- to enhance productivity, scalability, quality consistency, safety, and delivery predictability
* Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems \- to reduce systemic repeat failures, accelerate decision\-making, and embed institutional delivery intelligence across Business Units (BUs)


 Operating at programme scale, the role ensures that Qiddiya moves from fragmented project\-based execution toward structured, repeatable, and performance\-driven delivery systems.
   

  

**Strategic Mandate**
* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC)
* Define and steer Qiddiya's MMC ambition, roadmap, and governance framework
* Identify scalable MMC opportunities across asset typologies
* Establish standards, decision pathways, and adoption frameworks to enable BU implementation
* Align with Procurement and Supply Chain to support manufacturing agreements and market feasibility
* Translate pilot outcomes into institutionalised standards and repeatable playbooks
* Monitor measurable impact on cost, schedule, quality, HSE, and sustainability performance


 The role does not replace BU delivery accountability; it enables structured and scalable adoption across the programme.
   

  

**Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems**
* Establish and govern a structured delivery knowledge\-sharing system across the Qiddiya programme
* Institutionalise lessons learned, best practices, and repeatable standards
* Create cross\-BU transparency mechanisms to reduce duplication and rework
* Implement structured feedback loops between Delivery, Logistics, Engineering, Procurement, and Commercial functions
* Embed a culture of constructive transparency, where learning accelerates performance rather than assigning blame


 Knowledge sharing is positioned as a performance accelerator and delivery control mechanism — not documentation.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide executive leadership for MMC and Delivery Learning initiatives in alignment with SDU mandate and TOM
* Translate systemic delivery risks and recurring failure patterns into structured institutional solutions
* Secure executive alignment and approvals for frameworks, governance models, and scaling strategies
* Ensure integration across Delivery, Procurement, Engineering/Design, Logistics, Commercial, and Digital functions
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery predictability, productivity, and cross\-BU coordination


**Success Measures**
**MMC**
* Demonstrable adoption of MMC solutions on eligible assets
* Improved schedule confidence and delivery consistency
* Established supplier/manufacturing pathways supporting scalable adoption
* Measurable performance gains on pilot implementations


**Delivery Learning**
* Reduction in repeat systemic issues and avoidable rework
* Increased cross\-BU coordination and visibility
* Sustained platform adoption and knowledge reuse
* Faster issue resolution cycles across delivery ecosystem


**Stakeholder Environment**
**Internal:**
 SDU Leadership; BU Delivery Directors; CDU/Implementation; Engineering/Design; Procurement \& Supply Chain; Logistics; Commercial/Contracts; Digital/IT; People \& Culture.
   

  

**External:**
 Delivery partners; Tier 1 contractors; modular/offsite manufacturers; technology providers; specialist consultants; supply chain ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Profile Requirements**
 This role requires a senior international development and delivery executive with demonstrated experience leading major programmes or large\-scale master developments.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 18 years' progressive experience in international real estate development, infrastructure, or complex construction environments
* Proven leadership in multi\-asset or giga\-project settings with concurrent project portfolios
* Experience operating in high\-growth, high\-complexity environments (e.g., national transformation or large urban developments)

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 HENSOLDT Middle East is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of projects and programmes within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This opportunity is exclusively open to Saudi Nationals.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation to completion, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, schedule, quality, and customer requirements. At Senior Project Manager level, the role includes leading multiple projects or large, complex programmes, managing cross\-functional teams, driving stakeholder engagement, and ensuring successful project outcomes aligned with business objectives.
   

  

**Qualification and experience:**
* Minimum technical qualification; Preferred Undergraduate Engineering qualification or similar qualification.
* PMP certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI) highly preferred.
* Experience in a Defence environment, preferably within the Electronic Warfare domain.
* Depending on level: experience in project management, operational management, customer and stakeholder management, non\-co\-located team leadership, and team leadership.
* Minimum ideal experience of 6–8 years in project management and delivery.


**Key technical skills:**
* Project planning and project control techniques and tools.
* Stakeholder management (internal and external) with strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Clear understanding of the project lifecycle and control of project outputs.
* Coordination of technical work and allocation of resources according to project needs.
* Scope and change management within complex project environments.
* Strong understanding of project finance principles for effective budget and cost control.
* Ability to lead and motivate diverse teams (engineers, operators, technicians, and support staff).
* Knowledge of project management methodologies such as PRINCE II, PMP, and Agile.
* Understanding of complex systems within a design and development environment.
* Application of Systems Engineering principles to project execution.


**Key responsibilities:** 
  

  

* Contractual Programme / Project Execution
* Create and maintain a Project Management structure and team.
* Coordinate the project kick\-off with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective scope management during project execution without negatively impacting schedule, technical, or cost objectives unless formally agreed.
* Use project execution, control, and monitoring tools (e.g., Qmuzik/SAP) and PMO\-defined KPIs as measures of performance.
* Deliver contracted project milestones to the end user as a total solution.
* Ensure requirements are formally agreed and documented for traceability during and after project execution within technical, schedule, and budget constraints.
* Participate in major contract scope change negotiations and/or requirements changes when required.
* Planning and Technical
* Plan projects to achieve the Business Case, including:
+ Resource planning
+ Budgeting
+ Scheduling
+ Creating and maintaining risk and issue logs

* Allocate Project Management resources to the execution of work.
* Monitor Project Management output and workload.
* Create, maintain, and monitor monthly delivery and expenditure forecasts.
* Manage procurement of parts according to project scope.
* Ensure and review regular project scope outputs by the project team and align execution plans accordingly.
* Work with technical teams, engineers, and external suppliers to ensure the proposed technical solution meets customer expectations in terms of functionality, maintainability, usability, and producibility.
* Collaborate with systems engineers to ensure proper gate reviews take place to support decision\-making and technical integrity.
* Ensure projects are properly executed and closed in line with the project management process.
* Conduct gate project meetings to ensure delivery according to agreed standards.
* Manage mitigation of risks and issues within the project.
* Reporting
* Serve as a bridge between external customers and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of goals and milestones.
* Regularly communicate with external customers and project teams to provide status updates and ensure alignment of activities with programme goals.
* Report externally to the client on project execution status (technical and schedule).
* Report internally on execution status in terms of financial, technical, schedule, and risk status to Programme Managers.
* Project Closure
* Conduct gate reviews for production readiness.
* Conduct reviews on costs, budget, and the technical solution of the project.
* Identify gaps and define future or follow\-up actions.
* Create a project closure report with recommendations.
* General
* Uphold Company Values and the PMO Code of Conduct by adhering to company policies and disciplinary codes.
* Represent the Client internally and ensure the “Voice of the Customer” is heard.
* Ensure company policies and procedures relating to Project Management are followed as practically reasonable.
* Execute any reasonable ad hoc duties assigned by Executive Management within the scope of the role.
* Suggest areas for improvement in internal processes and propose solutions.
* Cooperate and add value within the PMO Business Unit wherever possible.

 HENSOLDT South Africa focuses on diversity, equity, and inclusion in our organizational strategy. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive corporate culture that benefits our employees and delivers better outcomes for our clients. In line with our commitment to equal employment opportunities and our focus on diversity in the operational environment, we welcome applications from all ethnic groups. In line with HENSOLDT's commitment to equal employment opportunities and our focus on diversity in the operational environment, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups.

 : 29 June 2026\.

Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

* Partner closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to ensure aligned business execution and operational efficiency.

**Responsibilities**
 TikTok LIVE connects creators and communities in real time, enabling interactive experiences and new monetisation opportunities. As part of TikTok’s regional management and support function, the Regional Headquarters is seeking a Regional Agency Strategy, Governance and Enablement Manager to support TikTok group entities across the MENAT region. The role will support the development of regional agency\-management strategy, training, performance analytics, policy implementation and operational governance, with local execution undertaken by the relevant operating entities.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Develop, maintain and support implementation of regional agency\-management policies, playbooks, onboarding standards and governance processes for TikTok LIVE across the MENA/MENAT region.
   

 2\. Support local operating entities in identifying, assessing and managing MCNs, agencies and creator organisations in accordance with approved regional standards, without directly contracting on behalf of the RHQ entity.
   

 3\. Design and deliver regional training materials and enablement programmes for internal teams on agency\-management processes, platform policies, compliance requirements and operational best practices.
   

 4\. Analyse regional agency performance data and provide recommendations to local operating entities and regional leadership on agency quality, category development and creator ecosystem trends.
   

 5\. Coordinate with product, policy, legal, compliance and local operations teams to improve regional agency\-management methodology and ensure consistent application of TikTok LIVE standards.
   

 6\. Contribute to regional business planning, operational governance and performance reporting for the LIVE creator agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

 \- Bachelor's degree or above.
   

 \- Deep passion for TikTok, mobile entertainment, social media, and popular culture.
   

 \- Experience in the live\-streaming industry and understanding of latest live\-streaming trends.
   

 \- Experience in regional strategy, business operations, governance, analytics, partner enablement or cross\-functional programme management within a technology, media, entertainment, social media or creator economy business.
   

  

 This role is based in the Company’s KSA Regional Headquarters and is responsible for providing regional strategy, management, governance, analytics, training and coordination support to Company group entities across the MENAT/MENA region. The role does not involve direct sales to customers, direct contracting with creators, agencies or users on behalf of the RHQ entity, or direct operation of local commercial activities. Execution of local market activities, contracting and revenue\-generating operations remains with the relevant local operating entities.
   

  

**About TikTok**
 TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​
   

  

  

**Why Join Us**
 Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.​
   

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​
   

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 Atkins are searching for a Senior Project Manager to join our team with experience of managing large\-scale multi\-disciplinary projects within KSA and the GCC Region. The candidate is to have a minimum of 15\+ years experience within the Middle East.
   

  

 The selected candidate will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects within the KSA and GCC Region. They will be responsible for leading and managing projects within the business. Their primary role is to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet client requirements.
   

  

 The selected candidate will work with the AtkinsRealis team and Client to establish project objectives, develop project plans, manage project budgets, and oversee project scheduling. They will be responsible for managing the project team, ensuring that team members are completing tasks on time and communication is maintained at all times.
   

  

 Other roles also include managing project risk, developing contingency plans and ensuring that health and safety standards are followed in addition to adherence of AtkinsRealis' project management methodology requirements.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Project Delivery**
* Communicate scope, fee, deliverables and programme with the team through Project Kick\-Offs and regular updates.
* Management of sub\-consultants' agreements and payments (technical management through Design Management function).
* Ensure that the Project Execution Plan addresses design management requirements, including integration and interface management between Client requirements, sub\-consultant design packages.
* Support the PD and PM in production of the Project Management suite of documents and standard forms.
* Assist in risk identification and management.
* Assist PD and PM to identify and manage scope changes, scope extensions.
* Identify resourcing issues and requirements and coordinate these with the Technical Team Leads.
* Escalate to PD / PM when/if required.
* Provide timely external and internal monthly reporting by implementing a planned delivery schedule for routine reporting.
* Ensure Quality Systems processes are adhered to in the delivery of projects.
* Undertake debriefs with Client.
* Assisting in managing the work financially, technically and contractually.


**Financial Management**
* Monitor Design Team progress and costs – Highlight where costs are not tracking as planned and coordinate with the Project Technical Leads to mitigate against potential over\-runs / underspends.
* Have a good understanding of Risk and the need to use their commercial acumen.
* Manage Risks proactively through use of the tools provided and regular team and Client engagement and update Contingency requirements regularly (min. once per design stage).
* Prepare Invoices for review and sign\-off by the Project Director and keep financial registers up to date.


**Client Management**
* Liaise and interact with the client for the technical delivery components of the project.


**About You**
* Technical/ Engineering Education and background.
* Minimum of 20 years' experience within the Middle East.
* Experience developing and implementing processes.
* Sharp background in:
+ Risk management (qualitative and quantitative).
+ Schedule management (schedule reviews, schedule various analysis).
+ Cost management (cost estimate, cost control and cost forecasting).
+ Contracts Management (Saudi Government procurement law and its executive bylaw).

 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

data.jd_text:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the leader for Joby’s future presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, you will build the business from the ground up, establishing the foundational relationships, operating model, and multi\-year strategy needed to launch a safe, compliant, and scalable service. Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the Business Foundation: Lay the foundation for the future KSA market for Joby
* Policy and Partnerships: In partnership with Joby’s senior leadership team, identify, build, and maintain strong relationships with local government entities, municipalities, and strategic partners to build trust and credibility, thereby strengthening Joby’s position in the KSA
* Corporate and Business Development: Source, evaluate, and execute M\&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Lead cross\-functional due diligence and manage deal execution from start to finish in the KSA
* Drive Strategic Execution: Implement a vision and multi\-year business strategy that balances execution across aircraft sales, business development, corporate development, government relations, OEM, manufacturing, and operations
* Develop Market Awareness: stay apprised of local trends, business opportunities, infrastructure opportunities, consumer mobility preferences, etc., within the KSA, and build action plans to exploit opportunities for Joby
* Collaborate with US Team: Work cross\-functionally with Joby’s US\-based headquarters functions to support global strategic initiatives and to support partner(s) in launching a successful, safe, and compliant service in the KSA
* Establish the Joby Brand Locally: Gather market insights and work closely with Joby’s marketing, business development, and communications teams to build a highly recognizable brand within the KSA
* Be the Local Face of Joby: Serve as the primary local representative of Joby at KSA events and with local press to drive awareness and early adoption
* Report to Joby Leadership: Provide regular updates on business performance and identify areas requiring support from the executive team and board of director s


**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in M\&A, Corporate Development, Program Management, Business Development, Government Relations, and/or Strategy
* 10\+ years of leadership experience, with increasing levels of responsibility
* Highly strategic thinker with strong business acumen and structured problem\-solving skills demonstrated through delivery of large complex projects/programs
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to influence at all levels,inspire teams, collaborate cross\-functionally, and represent the organization with external stakeholders
* An entrepreneurial mindset is suited for launching and scaling a new entity
* Exceptional ability to build and execute on a growth strategy
* Extensive professional network within the KSA and the Middle East, and proven ability to develop and maintain relationships
* Fluent in English and Arabic, both written and verbal communication
* Able to travel up to 30% of the time, including to the United States
* Legally able to work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or have the ability to be sponsored for a work visa


**Desired**
* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant industry
* Strong policy exposure and knowledge of regulatory frameworks (GACA, FAA, EASA)
* Proven track record of P\&L management
* Experience in the aviation or aerospace industry
* Previously launched and scaled a business or business unit
* Broad business experience in the Middle East
* Experienced in government and military relations and operations


**Additional Information**
**Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

This role offers the chance to manage the end\-to\-end delivery of campus expansions, refurbishment, and fit\-out programmes, ensuring projects are completed on time, on budget, and to a high standard while supporting our mission to create excellent learning environments.
   

  

 The Senior Project Manager will own the project lifecycle from planning and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover. * Drive site\-based project management including programme management, site supervision, quality control, health \& safety compliance and statutory approvals.
* Implement effective quality assurance and commissioning processes to ensure completed works meet functional, technical and safety standards.
* Manage stakeholder engagement with school leaders, operations, finance and external authorities to align project delivery with operational needs and academic calendars.
* Provide mentorship and line management to project team members and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery frameworks and templates.

* Minimum 7\+ years’ relevant experience managing design and construction projects with responsibility for budgets, programmes and procurement.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience of contract administration (NEC, JCT, FIDIC or equivalent).

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented
 **Senior Land Surveyor**

The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well\-being.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Report to the Resident Engineer/Construction Director and act as the lead surveyor for all site surveying and setting‑out verification activities.

* Identify and report any discrepancies between design drawings and site conditions, and support the supervision team in resolving setting‑out issues.
* Coordinate survey activities with discipline engineers (roads, structures, wet and dry utilities, hardscape, landscape) to support interface and clash avoidance.
* Maintain and ensure proper use, calibration, and safekeeping of survey equipment (total stations, GPS/GNSS, levels, laser instruments, etc.).
* Manage and maintain an organized digital and hard\-copy record of survey data, field notes, and as‑built information for future reference and handover.
* Support the verification of earthwork quantities, volumetric calculations, and measurement to assist the project’s commercial and quantity surveying teams.
* Participate in progress and coordination meetings and provide survey\-related inputs, constraints, and recommendations.
* Ensure all survey activities are carried out in accordance with HSE requirements, safe work practices, and Parsons quality procedures.
* Assist in the preparation and review of as‑built drawings and final survey records for handover to the client and relevant authorities.

* Bachelor's degree in Surveying Engineering from a recognized institution.
* in land/engineering surveying on large\-scale infrastructure, public realm, or urban development projects, including at least several years in a senior or lead surveyor role.
* Strong proficiency in the use of modern survey instruments and software, including total stations, GPS/GNSS, digital levels, and survey data processing tools.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Solid understanding of surveying principles, coordinate systems, leveling, and construction setting‑out for civil, structural, and landscape works.
* Proven experience working in a site\-based construction supervision environment, verifying contractor setting‑out and as‑built data.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering, architectural, and utility drawings and translate them into precise field layouts.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and record\-keeping, with a commitment to accuracy and quality.
* Good communication and coordination skills, able to work effectively with multi\-disciplinary teams and contractors.
* Experience in KSA or the GCC region is preferred.

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and delivery of the core Cultural Festival programming, ensuring a high\-impact, large\-scale cultural program that drives visitor engagement and aligns with asset objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, produce, deliver, and manage a high\-volume portfolio of festival programming, including coordination of over 1,400 performances, events, and cultural activities
* Structure programming across multiple zones and time slots to optimize flow and engagement
* Ensure alignment with overall programming strategy and visitor demand, in coordination with Commercial, Cultural Ecosystem, and Marketing teams
* Identify, engage, and manage third\-party program experts, producers, and cultural partners to develop, produce, and deliver festival programming

* Coordinate onboarding, scheduling, and management of performers, artists, and contributors including regional, international, and government\-affiliated participants and partners
* Ensure readiness of all participants, including rehearsals, technical requirements and performance delivery
* Manage high\-volume and diverse participant groups, ensuring seamless coordination and consistent quality


**Real\-Time Operations \& Optimization**
* Monitor program performance during the festival and adjust schedules dynamically
* Address operational challenges in real time in coordination with Operations
* Ensure continuity and quality under high\-pressure conditions


**Performance Monitoring**
* Track attendance, engagement, and program effectiveness across the festival
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming content
* Provide insights to improve future festival programming


**Key Success Metrics**
* Festival attendance and engagement
* On\-time delivery of programming

* Experience in large\-scale event programming

**Requirements**
* 6\-10 years of experience, with a strong background in large\-scale event programming, festival management, or live event delivery

* Experience handling last\-minute changes, disruptions, and operational challenges during live events
* Experience managing large numbers of performers, artists, and cultural contributors
* Ability to coordinate rehearsals, technical requirements, and performance schedules
* Experience ensuring readiness and smooth delivery across diverse participant groups
* Experience managing programming across multiple stages, zones, or venues simultaneously
* Ability to coordinate parallel activities while maintaining consistency and quality
* Strong understanding of crowd flow, timing, and programming distribution
* Experience leading teams, coordinators, and on\-ground staff during live events
* Experience in major national events, festivals, or large public events
* Experience in cultural or entertainment programming environments
* Experience in pre\-opening or launching large\-scale events is an advantage

Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director \- Project Director Design to lead the design aspects of our Strategic Development Unit (SDU).  The Senior Director provides leadership in establishing and maintaining design and consultancy management framework, governance and operating model for QDC HQ team. Ensures the design processes are developed and rolled out to all Business units / sectors, supports delivery in BUs when required. Provides leadership for assigned HQ special projects accountable for meeting quality, time, budget and HSSE requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish/update design and project management framework for all delivery methods (including Self\-Delivery, Delivery partner, CM, traditional etc.)
* Develop / update policies, processes, procedures, manuals and templates for design and consultancy (including PMC) for all projects and delivery methods
* Define governance process including detailed RACI matrix for all projects for Stages
* Support / coordinate with HQ Operations Director and Project Director (Delivery) in establishing governance and operational model for the complete program lifecycle
* Develop Design Strategy requirements and template to be applied for all projects and delivery methods
* Coordinate Technical / Peer review design management process and requirements with the Technical Director
* Develop/Update Health Safety Security and Environmental management requirements for the design phase including Design HSSE Reviews, co\-ordinate with HSE and Security Managers
* Develop/Update Sustainability management requirements for the design phase. co\-ordinate with Sustainability Managers
* Support MMC Director in establishing and overall MMC strategy and design integration process for all delivery models
* Support Procurement Director in establishing design and consultancy requirements and standards for prequalification and RFP processes. Participate when required in consultant selection process
* Support HQ Executive director in presentations and submittal for business line, project and budget approvals
* Accountable for delivery of special/assigned HQ projects including all approvals, reporting, management of internal and external stakeholders, financial closure and handover
* Accountable for compliance of special/assigned HQ projects with all QDC policies, processes, procedures and requirements, ensuring that the project meets HSE, budget, schedule and quality standards and requirements
* Support Business units in project delivery with peer reviews, consultant selection and management (when required), project audits to ensure compliance with established processes, procedures and standards for design and consultancy (including PMC)
* Coordinates input from Business units on the HQ management and governance framework processes and standards, updates documentation as part of the continuous improvement cycle
* Leads/support preparation of training materials required for the implementation of policies, processes and procedures, participates in training or presentations when required
* Participates in QDC Mentoring and Capability Building programs


**Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in architecture or engineering as minimum
* Master's Degree in related fields is preferred


**Specific Skills Required**
* Significant experience (5\+ years) in KSA within large‑scale developments or giga‑projects
* Thorough knowledge of procurement governance, strategic sourcing, and supply chain management principles
* Proven experience establishing procurement frameworks, policies, and assurance models for complex, multi‑project programs
* Strong understanding of multiple delivery models, including Self‑Delivery, Construction Management, Delivery Partner, and Traditional contracting
* Demonstrated experience in strategic and long‑lead procurement, market engagement, and supplier capacity management
* Proven leadership in providing central functional procurement services to internal Business Units and senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills across executive leadership, project teams, CPU, consultants, contractors, and suppliers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* High level of professionalism, judgment, and commercial acumen
* Strong problem‑solving and risk management capability
* Excellent time management and ability to operate effectively under pressure


**Experience**
* 20\-25 years' experience, of which at least 5 years have been in a senior leadership role within procurement, commercial, or supply chain functions on major programs or large‑scale developments


 Applications closing on 1st July 2026\.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Mining based in Riyadh, KSA, to establish and lead our Major Programs Mining \& Minerals business line in the region. This strategic leadership role will combine business development, project delivery oversight, commercial and financial management, and client relationship excellence to drive growth and successful delivery in one of our key sectors. As a leader within the Middle East region, with global connectivity, this role will require a blend of technical expertise, project leadership, business development acumen, and strategic client engagement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for shaping the direction of the mining business line, building strong teams, and delivering complex, major mining programs that align with WSP’s global standards and regional ambitions
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Strategy:**
* Serve as the founding leader for WSP’s Mining \& Minerals major programs business in the Middle East, establishing market presence and credibility.
* Navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural dynamics, and client expectations to build a sustainable business footprint.
* Define and execute the growth strategy for the Mining \& Minerals business line across the Middle East.
* Identify and pursue new market opportunities, capitalize on your existing relationships with government entities, mining operators, and strategic investors.
* Lead bid preparation and proposal development, including pricing, risk assessments, and contract terms.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, and effectively represent WSP in meetings, workshops, and site\-based engagements.
* Prepare proposals, technical reports, and client\-facing documentation aligned with project and business objectives.
* Lead the setup and execution of PMC frameworks for large\-scale mining programs.
* Develop delivery models tailored to regional client needs, including owner’s team services and integrated project controls.


**Strategic Oversight of Advisory \& Design Streams:**
* Provide strategic leadership for the Mining Advisory and Design service lines.
* Ensure alignment with global technical teams and leverage international expertise to support and grow regional delivery.
* Drive integration across service lines to create a unified client offering – from pit to port, from exploration to closure.


**Project Delivery \& Operations:**
* Provide leadership and oversight for the successful end\-to\-end delivery of major mining projects including feasibility studies, mine planning, delivery, and closure phases.
* Implement and enforce project delivery governance, quality standards, safety protocols, and risk management frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless project execution and client satisfaction.


**Client Relationship \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key clients, government agencies, regulators, and industry partners.
* Represent WSP at industry forums, conferences, and stakeholder meetings to enhance brand positioning and business opportunities.
* Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve client outcomes and exceed expectations.


**Commercial \& Financial Leadership:**
* Take full P\&L accountability for the Mining \& Minerals major programs business line, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Manage commercial agreements, contracts, claims, and scope changes to protect company interests and maximize profitability.
* Drive cost control initiatives and optimize resource allocation.


**Leadership \& Team Development:**
* Recruit, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of mining professionals across technical, commercial, and operational disciplines.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, Mineral Processing, Geology, or related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in the mining sector, with exposure to consulting and operator\-side roles in the Middle East region.
* Familiarity with regional mining regulations, standards, and market dynamics is highly desirable.
* Proven track record in business development and establishing new business lines or service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P\&L, contracts, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale mining projects or programs in the Middle East or similar regions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and drive change effectively.


 Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
   

  

 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

 With us, you can. Apply today.

**Job Description**
 The Case Manager is responsible for monitoring all activities and successfully facilitating a patient’s case from enrollment to the program through case completion while providing an exceptional customer experience throughout the entire process. This position reports to the Regional Business unit Director and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Specific Job Responsibilities**
* Manage patient cases from the beginning of the referral to final resolution including appeal approvals in a timely fashion


 ○ Review case upon receipt of referral to determine appropriate next steps based on defined process
   

  

 ○ Contact patients / caregivers to discuss copay assistance programs as needed
   

  

 ○ Place follow up calls to patients / caregivers to retrieve program documentation including but not limited to patient authorization / consent form, obtaining missing information and retrieving denial letters
   

  

 ○ Assist customers to navigate healthcare insurance reimbursement issues through education, information and exceptional communication and to minimize coverage issues
   

  

* Manage communications with patient, providers and internal team members


 ○ Constantly update the tracking system to ensure timely and smooth coordination for the patient and providers
   

  

 ○ Answer incoming hotline calls (from patients, facilities, HCPs, Kite team members etc.), as needed
   

  

 ○ Field customer complaints and respond in a timely manner
   

  

 ○ Enter case data into the program system
   

  

 ○ Respond to emails and case\-related questions from internal and external customers that need to be addressed immediately by a case manager
   

  

 ○ Participate in regular check\-ins and meetings with team
   

  

* Lead coordination efforts between multiple parties including but not limited to patients, providers, physicians and their staff, treatment center billing departments, insurance companies and patient assistance programs


 ○ Constantly keep physician and physician’s team updated on the status of the case
   

  

 ○ Facilitate and manage the coordination of the product and ancillary supplies needed for treatment, document and manage all communication during the process
   

  

 ○ Ensure timelines and customer commitments are met
   

  

* Coordinate with internal quality, supply chain and other internal teams to execute the process and resolve issues


 ○ Act as the functional expert for the Kite Konnect™ Hospital Portal
   

  

 ○ Act as the interface between the Kite Pharma Account and Quality teams regarding site identification, approval and scheduling training
   

  

 ○ Attend and assist with site visit training, customer and patient meetings
   

  

**Experience Required**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (both in English and Local language) with the ability to establish effective relationships with a range of internal cross\-functional teams, healthcare provider team(s) and customers
* Effective problem solving, case management and customer service skills
* Strong ability to coordinate with both customer and non\-customer facing cross\-functional partners to rapidly address customer issues
* Bachelor's degree


**Knowledge**
* Ability to multi\-task across a wide variety of tactical and strategic activities.
* Able to effectively manage others in accomplishing necessary tasks, both direct reports and others in related areas of Gilead.
* Able to influence and provide recommendations to senior management.
* Ability to recognize and interpret business issues/opportunities and recommend solutions through analysis, then implement and/or negotiate solutions with external parties.
* Excellent analytical skills with an emphasis on follow\-through, and issue resolution abilities.
* Microsoft Excel/Word \& PowerPoint and strong working knowledge of order management and information management systems.

 Please apply via the Internal Career Opportunities portal in Workday.

 The University is continuously expanding, and its campus is located in north\-central Riyadh.
   

  

* We offer a one\-year renewable contract (renewable subject to Dean/Director and student evaluations) and a competitive salary package based on academic qualification, rank, and teaching experience as stated above.

 Prince Sultan University is the first private university in Saudi Arabia that emphasizes excellence in teaching, research and community services. It is also the first private university to have been awarded ACCREDITATION by the NCAAA (National Commission for Assessment \& Academic Accreditation). Further, it is the youngest university to have achieved such a milestone.
   

  

**Required**
 PSU offers a Preparatory Year Program in which students develop their English, Mathematics, Computer, and Physical Education/Health and Recreation skills to the standards required for study in the following English\-medium undergraduate courses:
   

  

* Computer and Information Systems
* Finance, Marketing, and Accounting
* Aviation Management.
* Engineering
* Law
* Architecture and Interior Design
* English, Translation and Applied Linguistics


**PSU Also Offers Graduate Programs Leading To**
* Master's in Business Administration (MBA)
* Master in Computer Information Systems
* Master's in Software Engineering/Cyber Security (MSE/MCS).
* Master's in Commercial Law


 Please visit our website: www.psu.edu.sa if you wish to learn more about PSU.
 **HOW TO APPLY**
 Apply with a cover letter and all required certificates and transcripts to:
   

  

**Email:** 
*pyprecruitment\_cvs@psu.edu.sa*

Further, it is the youngest university to have achieved such a milestone.

* Computer and Information Systems

**PSU Also Offers Graduate Programs Leading To**
