data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist SVP/ VP to drive cultural change around Lean across QNB Group. The incumbent will be responsible for leading and managing the Group’s Lean and Six Sigma agenda under the Innovation department. Responsibility includes owning, leading and managing selected portfolio of Lean projects across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial: \- Deliver and execute on the initiation, execution and implementation of operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope and support divisions within QNB Group \- Assist the VP to develop and deploy Lean/ Six Sigma/ Change Management standards and the process improvement methodology within QNB Group \- Contribute to develop/ create the metrics/ key performance indicators (KPIs), for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes related to dedicated operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives on a periodic basis \- Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President, Lean Transformation role. \- Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank. \- Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External): \- Ensure relevant training and coaching on the methodology to designated multipliers within the organization \- Drive operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope, with a focus on customer orientation, service and service quality \- Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions and \- Deliver training and coaching of others in applying Lean/ Six Sigma and process reengineering methodology \- Assist in creating awareness within QNB Group for client orientation, quality and efficiency \- Establish and maintain strong working relationships and support units within QNB Group with regards to operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives as well as with regards to Lean/ Six Sigma tools \- Identify new solutions or processes into ongoing operations within QNB Group.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- Interact with SVP/ VP Lean Transformation to obtain new process improvement mandates and participate in project idea generation, selection and scoping \- Support the business and support divisions in successfully managing and leading the implementation of strategic initiatives under his/ her scope \- Identify benefits, quantify targeted results, establish measurement criteria and assist in the prioritization of process improvement initiatives \- Manage or assist the VP to manage multiple projects and/ or assume the role of leading a larger projects under his/ her scope \- Direct and control all work performed within the project framework of the DMAIC phases \- Ensure projects under his/ her scope remain on time, on budget and deliver expected results \- Ensure industry best practices and standards within the execution of process improvement assignments \- Evaluate data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and associated issues and risks and perform statistical process analyses \- Provide advice, input and guidance to process improvement teams regarding change management, process redesign strategies, performance improvement toolsets (especially those of Six Sigma and Lean), and technical expertise, such as statistical process control and data analysis \- Coach internal process improvement teams to further refine and develop Lean/ Six Sigma tools within QNB Group to improve the quality and service \- Participate in the deployment of other performance improvement methodologies.
* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Identify related areas for professional self\-development. Ensure the provision of relevant guidance, direction and training to subordinates to develop and enhance their skills \- Defines further training needs required and is responsible for career development of his subordinates \- Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). \- Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. \- Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. \- All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Bachelor Degree from leading academic institution with focus on business administration
   

  

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in organization and process reengineering, business consulting and project management or equivalent business/ operations experience within the financial services arena (however: no specialization in one area but rather multiskilling and transversal across functions)
* Strong operational and project management experience \- Experience in directing and managing large projects as well as managing change
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt with minimum of 5 years’ experience and technical mastery
* Demonstrated track record using Lean Six Sigma Methodology principles and practices
* Minimum of two years’ experience as lead instructor to train Black Belts and/ or Green Belts
* Experience in coaching a minimum of five Lean Six Sigma projects from initiation to closure
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and excellent team leadership skills and potential
* Strong knowledge of financial services from an operational and support perspective


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Highest Education Certificate

**Project Director – Data Centres \| Qatar** 




  





 An exciting opportunity has arisen with a leading EPC contractor delivering some of the Middle East's most complex and high\-profile digital infrastructure developments.
 



  





 We are seeking an accomplished
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of hyperscale and large\-scale colocation data centre projects across the MENA region. This executive leadership role will be responsible for the overall success of multiple mission\-critical developments, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and operational performance.
 



  





 The successful candidate will provide strategic direction across all phases of the project lifecycle, from early planning and design management through procurement, construction, commissioning, and final handover, while maintaining strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide executive leadership for the successful delivery of hyperscale and large\-scale colocation data centre projects.
* Oversee all aspects of project execution, including design management, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
* Establish and drive project strategy, governance frameworks, and delivery methodologies aligned with client objectives and organisational standards.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams comprising project managers, design managers, construction managers, commercial professionals, and technical specialists.
* Ensure effective management of programme schedules, project budgets, risk registers, and resource allocation across multiple workstreams.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, senior stakeholders, consultants, utility providers, and supply chain partners.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and maintain strong relationships with hyperscale operators and key project partners.
* Champion health, safety, quality, and environmental excellence across all project activities.
* Oversee commercial performance, including contract administration, change management, claims mitigation, and financial reporting.
* Monitor project performance against key milestones and implement corrective actions to address potential delays or risks.
* Lead project governance meetings and provide regular executive\-level reporting to internal leadership and external stakeholders.
* Support commissioning strategies, operational readiness planning, and the successful transition to client operations teams.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 10 years' experience delivering large\-scale construction projects, with significant exposure to mission\-critical facilities and data centres.
* Proven track record leading hyperscale or major colocation data centre developments from inception through to completion.
* Extensive experience managing multidisciplinary teams within complex EPC, PMC, or client\-side environments.
* Strong understanding of data centre delivery requirements, including critical power, cooling infrastructure, commissioning, and operational resilience.
* Demonstrated expertise in programme management, commercial oversight, contract administration, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working with internationally recognised forms of contract and large, geographically dispersed project teams.
* Middle East experience is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with hyperscale client standards and delivery expectations, including those of AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Oracle, would be advantageous.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, negotiation, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively at executive level.



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a market\-leading organisation at the forefront of the region's rapidly expanding data centre sector and play a pivotal role in delivering next\-generation digital infrastructure that will support the future of the digital economy.

* Expert understanding of both explicit and implicit dependencies and able to explain these and build into recommendations
* Experience of implementing successful project performance improvement activities and techniques for recovering poor performance
* Knowledge of supplier categorisation and experienced in devising appropriate commercial acquisition strategies
* Understands the needs of information management requirements in the project phases (operation), internal (contractual, statutory) and asset (customer) documentation.

About Us:
 



 Ooredoo is a dynamic global Telecommunications player operating in 10 countries serving more than 138 million customers. Ooredoo Qatar employs approximately 1,600 people driving Ooredoo to be the number one choice for world\-class communications services in Qatar, and it is a team that you can be part of!
 



  





 About the Role:
 



 This role is responsible for overseeing all commercial aspects of existing and new projects to ensure they meet the highest standards of excellence. This position plays a significant role in the division's transformative efforts, establishing effective operational practices both internally and externally. The position holder drives commercial success by delivering compelling commercial bids and proposals to OQ customers across various segments while managing a portfolio of projects. Strong commercial ownership and effective program and resource management are essential for coordinating diverse project components and maintaining OQ's competitive edge in the market. This role requires expertise in large\-scale Telco and ICT projects, bid and contract management, telecom B2B offerings, proposal pricing, and resource management. Additionally, the role holder will establish and oversee best practices in project and commercial management, acting as a vital authority and knowledge multiplier in the B2B sector. A key responsibility is to enhance the technical capabilities and hands\-on approach of project managers, ensuring alignment with OQ's product and business objectives.
 



  





 Functional Context:
 



 Ooredoo’s Business BU is a critical part of the company’s first line customer facing activities for all Business Accounts and has a significant role to play in long term business value creation through product design, achievement of sales revenue, profit and customer satisfaction, as defined in the annual business plans. The Commercial and Project Management department is an integral part of the Business Solutions Division. Its mandate is to enhance commercial focus and ownership during the proposal management process, ensuring that OQ can compete for more deals and improve the conversion rate with favorable conditions. The department oversees the delivery of larger, complex deals (known as Mega Projects) by adhering to rigorous project management practices that encompass the technical, commercial, and operational aspects of the customer\-proposed solution. The team is also charged commercial and project/program management frameworks and tools to ensure high\-quality outcomes, mitigate risks, and provide progress reports to management. They produce high\-quality RFx responses and proposals within deadlines, ensuring OQ's market competitiveness. Additionally, they manage client solution pricing, incorporating OQ products, managed services, bespoke solutions, advisory and consulting, partner offerings, support, and various SLA levels. Achieving these goals involves extensive internal and external collaboration and stakeholder management.
 



  






 Role Accountabilities:
 




 • Define and articulate the strategic vision for commercial and project management, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and market dynamics.
 



 • Cultivate and maintain robust relationships with senior leadership, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project and bid goals.
 



 • Establish and oversee key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate project success and commercial effectiveness, driving a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
 



 • Identify and assess potential risks within project portfolios and commercial bids, developing proactive strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure compliance.
 



 • Champion leadership development and professional growth within the project management and bids teams, fostering a high\-performance culture.
 



 • Promote and implement best practices in commercial and project management, establishing a reputation as a key authority and knowledge leader.
 



 • Lead transformative initiatives within the business solutions division to drive innovation, operational excellence, and enhanced value delivery across projects and bids.
 



 • Drive strategic oversight of all commercial activities, ensuring seamless alignment from opportunity management through proposal submission and project initiation to enhance transitions to project delivery teams.
 



 • Supervise the commercial elements of proposals, emphasizing timelines, financial conditions, risks, and adherence to organizational objectives to elevate bid quality.
 



 • Co\-lead high\-stakes negotiations with clients, securing terms that optimize revenue and profitability while fostering long\-term partnerships.
 



 • Strategically manage scope changes, ensuring alignment of change orders with project contracts and client expectations for successful execution.
 



 • Provide executive\-level guidance to project teams on commercial and contractual matters, instilling best practices across all project phases.
 



 • Oversee a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring adherence to guidelines, financial milestones, and budgets while implementing corrective actions as needed.
 



 • Establish and implement robust quality assurance processes to uphold delivery standards for both internal OQ products/services and vendor\-managed projects, including regular audits to drive continuous improvement.
 



 • Lead comprehensive project progress reporting, focusing on financial performance and providing high\-level strategic recommendations to enhance overall project outcomes.
 



 • Oversee a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring adherence to guidelines and targets while implementing corrective actions as needed.
 



 • Direct project progress reporting, focusing on financial milestones and budgets, and provide strategic recommendations.
 



 • Implement quality assurance processes to uphold project delivery standards covering both OQ internal products/services as well as direct through vendors., including regular audits for improvement.
 



 • Clearly communicate deliverables, manage scope creep, and address variances from original requirements.
 



 • Conduct post\-implementation reviews to drive continuous improvement.
 



 • Analyze financial data to seek ways to maximize revenue, analyzing profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates, and utilization across projects.
 



 • Develop and maintain detailed, cross functional project plans \& schedules, identifying risk and interdependencies as well as contract variations/additional work orders and the like to maximize Ooredoo revenues from all projects and minimise losses.
 



 • Lead a team of project managers, bid specialists, and pricing analysts to secure new business opportunities, particularly within large enterprise industry verticals and government segments.
 



 • Work closely with the Contract Management team to develop standard T\&Cs and contractual requirements, both on customer and vendor back\-to\-back, as well as in special customer conditions for specific cases.
 



 • Jointly observe the delivery milestone with commercial implications on customer and vendor side as well.
 



 • Coordinate the scoping, delivery milestones and costing of the offered solution, products and services with Product Hub, Professional and Managed Services as well as operations for delivery and support.
 



 • Maintain the commercial authority during the implementation phase advising project management and delivery teams on terms on conditions with customer and external partners and vendors.
 



 • Set and track the ongoing project budget, margin levels, risk, resource forecasts and financial reports.
 



 • Manage and coach commercial and project team resources to ensure short\- and long\-term profitability through excellence in commercial strategy and execution.
 



 • Provide the right resources to ensure optimal process execution through effective and efficient human resource planning.
 



 • Participate in contract negotiations with Ooredoo clients ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and profitability targets.
 



 • Oversee commercial performance of projects and procedures to calibrate best practices and continual improvement techniques.
 



 • Lead and mentor the commercial and project management team to ensure personal and professional growth for each member, while developing their skills to deliver high quality Commercial results and hands\-on Project Management results for OQ customers.
 



  





 Minimum Entry Qualifications:
 



 Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or Marketing or Engineering
 



  





 Minimum Experience, Essential Knowledge \& Skills:
 



 12 years' experience in a similar role. Eexpertise in commercial and project management within a telecommunications or ICT vendor organization. Experience in managing large and complex projects, pricing and large bids, procurement for government or large enterprises, or within the commercial team of a system integrator are essential

data.jd_text:
ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Operations Lead DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





  





**How you’ll make a difference** 




 The Operations Lead is responsible for the operational backbone of DEEP Qatar. They keep the Qatar site running, manage operational tracking of the program budget, and provide operational support across the three flagship programs (DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha).
 



 They bring local knowledge of business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the wider GCC to support the team in navigating the local environment effectively. In year one, this means supporting the establishment of an operation from scratch in a new market. In year two and beyond, it means scaling that operation as the programs mature.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 









**Entity, governance, and office operations** 




 Primarily responsible for keeping the Qatar entity operational. Stay on top of day\-to\-day compliance obligations such as accounting, HR, legal, IT, and office operations. Support the relationship with the company secretary and external legal counsel. Support the operational management of banking relationships, including account administration, vendor payments, and expense systems. Manage office leases, vendor contracts, and supplier relationships. Lead the operational logistics for local new\-hire onboarding.
 



**Program budget and operations support** 




 Manage operational tracking of the various program budgets. Track costs, reconcile spend against budget allocations, and report regularly to the Director. Support the Program Manager with project\-level budget management.
 



 Provide operational support across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha, including support for Academy curriculum refinement and ecosystem day preparation alongside the Director and Program Manager. Coordinate with the Berlin team on operational alignment, shared services, and reporting.
 



**Business systems and processes** 




 Set up and maintain the tools and processes that support the Director and the wider team in business development, partnership management, and operational delivery. This includes CRM, pipeline tracking, internal reporting, and operational workflows.
 



**Local partnership and ecosystem intelligence** 




 Support the Director with institutional knowledge of local business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the GCC region. Provide intelligence and brief the team on the regional entrepreneur and innovation ecosystem, including key accelerators, networks, and communities relevant to Pioneers and CDL scouting. Maintain awareness of local vendors relevant to program delivery and share that intelligence with the team.
 



**Equipment and IT** 




 Lead local equipment management, including sourcing, maintenance, and inventory of IT hardware, screens, AV equipment, and connectivity. Resolve day\-to\-day local IT and infrastructure issues so the team can work without disruption.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit.** 




 You are an operator with strong institutional knowledge of how things work in Qatar and the wider GCC. You combine the operational rigour to run an entity, track a budget and build systems with the local instinct to spot what matters and flag it early. You have direct experience of working with or inside Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government institutions, and you bring that experience to bear in helping the team navigate the local environment effectively. You are comfortable being hands\-on across operations, finance and systems in a small, scaling team without a playbook.
 



 Must\-haves
 


* 5 to 8 years of professional experience with meaningful time spent living or working in Qatar or the wider GCC
* Strong working knowledge of local business practices, customs and how decisions get made in the region
* Operational management experience in an international organisation, including budget tracking and financial reporting
* Working Arabic
* Experience in standing up new operations or geographies
* Comfortable operating in a small, scaling team with a limited playbook



 Strong preferences
 


* Institutional experience of the Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government agencies
* Background in startup, accelerator, university or innovation ecosystem
* Experience setting up and managing CRM, pipeline tracking or operational systems
* Experience managing IT, vendor and supplier relationships in a small\-team environment



 Nice to have
 


* Existing relationships with QSTP, Qatar Foundation, QRDI, QIA or the major Qatari universities.



  





**What makes this more than just a job** 




 ESMT offers a collegial and international work environment, with employees representing more than 55 nationalities. We encourage a self\-driven mind\-set and contributions that create meaningful and lasting impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a fair and inclusive workplace where individuals of all identities and backgrounds are welcomed and valued. Fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion enriches our employees, students, and broader community.
 



  





**We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you!** 




 Please submit your application via our online application form, including the following documents:
 


* Motivation letter
* CV with relevant certificates and references
* Salary expectations and possible start date.

 ESMT Berlin

 The Head of Operations will build the EMEA operational framework for this business line, integrating it seamlessly into the company's established processes while ensuring it operates with commercial discipline, efficiency, and scalability, all whilst ensuring alignment with the global ISA community to drive standardisation.
   

  

 This role requires a leader who can create a tightly integrated delivery engine that ensures quality, efficiency, margin control, and regulatory readiness, without duplicating the company’s infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with a solid understanding of professional services, preferably within audit or advisory environments.
   

  

****Responsibilities \& Accountabilities****
* Process: This role will collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define the client journey for ISA throughout EMEA whilst working closely with global teams to ensure alignment.

* Is clearer, better understood, and aligned and embedded across the globe.
* Is more efficient and effective in servicing both EMEA and global client contracts.
* Is considerate and aligned to the future direction and growth of the ISA business.
* incorporates governance and transparency at its core.
* Effectively leverages existing best practices
* Operational delivery: This role will be responsible for working with direct reports and other regional leaders to mobilise our teams to deploy a client\-centric solution across our clients. They will maintain within the region the competencies and roles required to support the operational delivery of the ISA programs, and collaborate with the respective regions to develop these competencies more widely to support EMEA programs.


**This Will Result In:**
* A clear framework of the competencies required when delivering an ISA program.
* Greater understanding of and alignment with the competencies adopted across the regions.
* Increased capacity and capability to support the ISA programs.

 **P\&L responsibility**

**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute the strategic vision, business plan, and growth objectives for the Data Centre Business Unit.

 This is a unique opportunity to lead a high\-growth business at the centre of the Middle East's digital transformation agenda. The successful candidate will have the platform to shape strategy, expand market presence, and deliver world\-class data centre infrastructure that will support the region's future economic and technological ambitions.

data.jd_text:
ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Program Manager, DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





**How you'll make a difference** 




 The Program Manager is central to executing DEEP Qatar's local initiatives and supporting the delivery of the three flagship programs: DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. They make sure every cohort week, venture session, and mentor gathering runs flawlessly on the ground in Doha, and help establish DEEP Qatar's brand presence locally through digital channels and a physical presence at ecosystem events.
 



 They work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin to maintain consistency with global CDL standards, and with the Doha\-based Venture Managers on local delivery and venture intake. In year one, this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, requiring the entrepreneurialism to figure things out in a new market without a local playbook.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Program delivery** 




 Own end\-to\-end local build and delivery for cohort sessions across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. Manage scheduling, logistics, venues, catering, and travel for participants, mentors, and faculty. Manage faculty, speakers, and practitioners across the programs, including onboarding, attendance, briefings, and on\-site coordination. Serve as the first point of contact for participants during cohort weeks. Ensure programs run to CDL global standards while adapting to the local context. Own project\-level budget management across programs, tracking spend and reporting into the overall Qatar program budget managed by the Operations Lead. Manage inbound inquiries.
 



**Berlin coordination** 




 Work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin (led by the Head of Operations) and the Berlin\-based Program Managers to ensure alignment across the DEEP network. Provide local execution support for Berlin\-led activities that involve Qatar and draw on Berlin's support for Qatar\-led cohorts, particularly during the first year of the programs.
 



**Venture Manager support** 




 Provide local logistical support to Venture Managers across the program verticals, including coordinating venture visits, founder sessions, and ecosystem touchpoints in Qatar. Support Venture Managers with the application process and onboarding of candidates and ventures into the programs.
 



**Ecosystem days and gatherings** 




 Lead the operational delivery of DEEP Qatar's ecosystem days, including gatherings that connect CDL ventures and mentors with the local startup, innovation, investment, and corporate community in Qatar. Manage logistics, venues, speakers, attendee management, and on\-the\-day execution alongside the Director, Operations Lead, and Venture Managers.
 



**Brand and local presence** 




 Support the establishment and growth of DEEP Qatar's brand presence in the local ecosystem through social media channels (such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and others) and produce content that feeds into Berlin's central channels. Coordinate with the Berlin team on brand consistency and execution. Represent DEEP Qatar at relevant ecosystem events, demo days, and gatherings alongside the Director.
 



**Vendor and supplier management** 




 Manage local vendors and suppliers required for program delivery, including venues, catering, AV, travel, and accommodation. Build a reliable Doha supplier network from a standing start.
 



**Participant data and reporting** 




 Track participant data, attendance, feedback, and core program KPIs. Provide regular delivery reports to the Director and Berlin counterparts.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit** 




 You are a program operator who takes pride in flawless delivery. You have run multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard, ideally in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events context. You are the calm center during intense cohort weeks. You are entrepreneurial enough to figure things out in a new market with no local playbook, and disciplined enough to run programs to a global standard. You are comfortable working across cultures and flexible when working across time zones.
 



 You enjoy being the person who makes things work. You are comfortable being hands\-on with logistics one moment and engaging with a senior researcher or venture founder the next.
 



**Must\-haves** 



* 4–6 years of program delivery experience
* Track record of running multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard
* Experience in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events environment
* Currently based in Qatar or the wider GCC, or open to relocating to Doha
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline



**Strong preferences** 



* GCC\-based experience or background
* Experience in a startup, accelerator, or university ecosystem



**Nice to have** 



* Working proficiency in Arabic



  





  





**What makes this more than just a job** 




 ESMT offers a collegial and international work environment, with employees representing more than 55 nationalities. We encourage a self\-driven mind\-set and contributions that create meaningful and lasting impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a fair and inclusive workplace where individuals of all identities and backgrounds are welcomed and valued. Fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion enriches our employees, students, and broader community.
 



  





  





**We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you!** 




 Please submit your application via our online application form, including the following documents:
 


* Motivation letter
* CV with relevant certificates and references
* Salary expectations and possible start date.



  





**Contact:**




 ESMT Berlin
 



 Viktoriya Rodina
 



 Human Resources Coordinator
 



 Schlossplatz 1
 



 10178 Berlin
 



 Tel: 030 21231 0

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded
 **IT Strategy \& Performance Manager** 
 to drive performance excellence, governance, and execution discipline across the IT function.
 



 This role acts as a key partner to IT leadership, enabling data\-driven decision making, strengthening delivery transparency, and ensuring alignment between IT strategy, operational execution, and business priorities.
 



 You will play a central role in shaping how IT performance is measured, tracked, and communicated across Run, Change, and Transform agendas.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and continuously enhance IT\-wide performance frameworks, translating IT strategy into measurable KPIs and execution metrics
* Develop and own executive\-level dashboards, management reports, and performance packs used in leadership reviews and steering committees
* Partner with IT leadership to cascade strategic priorities into structured performance tracking and reporting mechanisms
* Conduct deep\-dive analysis across IT portfolios, identifying risks, inefficiencies, capacity constraints, and improvement opportunities
* Convert complex operational, delivery, and financial data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Lead performance reviews across key IT domains including service delivery, transformation programs, operational resilience, and cost efficiency
* Establish and maintain governance standards for KPI definitions, reporting cadence, data quality, and performance transparency
* Provide quality assurance and challenge to performance narratives and reporting submitted to senior leadership forums
* Coordinate across IT teams to ensure alignment of priorities, initiatives, and delivery timelines
* Prepare high\-quality executive presentations and materials for leadership and board\-level discussions
* Coach junior team members where applicable, promoting analytical rigor and strong stakeholder communication



**Candidate Profile** 



* 8\-12 years of professional experience
* **Background in top\-tier consulting or similar environments such as McKinsey \& Company, Boston Consulting Group, Bain \& Company, Kearney, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, or Accenture**
* Strong experience in IT strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating models
* Proven expertise in performance management, IT KPIs, dashboards, or portfolio tracking
* Strong analytical capability with ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate data into insights
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience engaging senior leadership
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with analytics or IT performance tools is a strong advantage
* Strong communication and storytelling ability with an executive\-level mindset



**Why Join** 




 This is a high\-impact role at the centre of IT strategy execution, offering visibility across all major technology initiatives and direct engagement with senior IT leadership. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how performance, governance, and transformation success are defined and delivered.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 The Vertical Operations Director is responsible for owning and scaling the operational performance of Snoonu’s key business verticals, including grocery, laundry, ticketing, and any future verticals launched under Snoonu’s ecosystem.
   

  

 This role ensures that each vertical operates with clear ownership, strong execution, high service quality, and profitable growth, while maintaining Snoonu’s customer obsession and operational standards.
   

  

 The Vertical Operations Director is not only responsible for day\-to\-day operations, but also for building scalable operating models, improving unit economics, solving cross\-functional issues, and ensuring that each Non\-food vertical is ready to grow in Qatar and future markets.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Grocery Operations


 Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick\-commerce partners.
   

  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out\-of\-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.
* Improve picking, packing, and handover processes with partners.
* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold\-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark\-store or quick\-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.
* Laundry Operations


 Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end\-to\-end laundry order flow.
   

  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high\-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.
* Ticketing Operations


 Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
   

  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event\-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.


**Additional Verticals And Business Areas**
 Based on Snoonu’s business model, the Vertical Operations Director may also oversee or support the following areas:
   

  

* Retail Operations


 For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
   

  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category\-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations


 Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
   

  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations


 Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
   

  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* Vertical Strategy and Operating Model ( Define the operating model for each vertical; Set operational priorities, KPIs, and service standards; Translate Snoonu’s business goals into clear execution plans).
* Operational Performance ( Own the day\-to\-day performance of each vertical; Monitor key metrics; Identify operational bottlenecks and solve them with clear owners; Ensure every vertical has weekly performance reviews and action plans).
* Customer Experience ( Ensure every vertical delivers a customer experience aligned with Snoonu’s standards; Work closely with Customer Experience and Customer Support to understand complaints and root causes; Reduce repeated failures that create customer dissatisfaction; Ensure service recovery rules are clear for each vertical; Protect the customer first, then fix the root cause internally) .
* Partner and Merchant Operational Excellence ( Set clear operational requirements for merchants and partners; Hold partners accountable for repeated failures; Work with commercial and account management teams to improve partner performance; Ensure partners understand Snoonu’s standards for preparation, availability, packaging, handover, and customer experience; Recommend corrective actions for underperforming partners).
* Cross\-Functional Leadership ( This role must connect all departments to ensure that vertical issues are solved end\-to\-end).
* SOPs, SLAs, and Governance ( Create and maintain SOPs for each vertical; Define clear SLAs for merchants, operations, logistics, and support teams; Build escalation processes for critical issues; Ensure every team knows who owns each type of problem; Standardize processes across verticals to reduce confusion and improve execution) .
* Data, Reporting, and Business Reviews ( Build dashboards for each vertical; Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance; Identify trends, risks, and repeated failures; Present clear business reviews to leadership; Convert data into action plans, not just reports).
* Profitability and Unit Economics ( Work with finance and commercial teams to improve vertical profitability; Monitor cost\-to\-serve across each vertical; Identify operational inefficiencies that affect margins; Improve delivery batching, fulfillment efficiency, partner terms, and refund leakage; Ensure growth does not come at the cost of poor economics).

data.jd_text:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Meet our Professional Services Team!**
 Successful implementation and value from the Sprinklr platform starts with us. As customers advance their strategies and invest more in social media as a business driver, we’re looking for experienced project managers to help realise those ambitions. As a member of our team, you’ll support our customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Sprinklr is looking for a Global Program Manager to lead one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client in Doha. You will be responsible and accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of the program, working with a retained team dedicated to the client.
   

  

 This is an on\-site role based in Doha, Qatar, supporting a public\-sector client. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the client site on a full\-time basis.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client, coordinating the retained team and controlling program scope, change control processes, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Partner with consulting teams, leaders and other internal departments or regional teams to coordinate and drive delivery.
* Ensure that overall program is effective, whilst running individual projects according to schedule and keeping within budget.
* Develop relationships and ensure the appropriate participation of key client \& internal stakeholders and executives.
* Develop, build, and maintain durable and trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Develop knowledge of the Sprinklr platform components and module\-synergies \- so as to be able to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and high\-level solutions.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed effectively.
* Manage client service expectations and briefs and drive successful, measurable outcomes for the client.
* Set the tone for the team and strive for quality and excellence in all aspects of delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn reports to the relevant project stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of the current industry environment that shapes opportunities for client solutions.


**Experience:**

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 A landmark, large\-scale mixed\-use destination development is underway in Qatar — one of the most ambitious leisure, retail, and real estate projects in the region. Spanning entertainment, hospitality, retail, and residential components across a significant land area in the greater Doha area, this project represents a generational investment in Qatar's tourism and economic diversification ambitions.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The project is at a pivotal stage of development, and we are seeking an exceptional Contracts \& Commercial Director to lead the full commercial and contracts function from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Contracts \& Commercial Director will be the most senior commercial authority on the project. This is a leadership role with strategic accountability for all contracts, procurement, cost management, and commercial governance across the entire development programme — spanning design, construction, fit\-out, retail leasing infrastructure, and operational commissioning phases. The successful candidate will build and lead a high\-performing commercial team, establish robust contract frameworks, protect the project's financial interests, and ensure that all commercial decisions are aligned with the project's master development strategy.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* **Contracts Management**
* Own end\-to\-end contract strategy, administration, and execution across all project workstreams including civil works, MEP, fit\-out, retail, leisure, and hospitality packages
* Lead the preparation, negotiation, and award of all major contracts (FIDIC, NEC, bespoke forms), ensuring appropriate risk allocation and commercial protection
* Manage the full claims lifecycle — anticipation, assessment, negotiation, and resolution — minimising exposure and disputes
* Establish and maintain a contract register, variation management system, and claims log with full governance and audit trail
* Interface with legal counsel on contractual disputes, arbitration, and enforcement matters
* 
* **Commercial Management**
* Develop and implement the project's overarching commercial strategy in alignment with the CEO and development board
* Own the project cost plan, budget, and cost\-to\-complete reporting, providing accurate and timely commercial reporting to senior leadership and ownership
* Lead value engineering initiatives without compromising design intent or operational quality
* Drive procurement strategy — packaging, market engagement, tendering, evaluation, and award — for all consultants, contractors, and specialist vendors
* Establish commercial governance frameworks including delegation of authority, approval workflows, and commercial risk registers
* Oversee the benchmarking of contract prices against market rates and comparable regional projects
* 
* **Retail \& Real Estate Commercial**
* Provide commercial oversight on retail leasing structures, anchor tenant agreements, and fit\-out contribution frameworks
* Advise on commercial terms for real estate sales, land disposal, and development management agreements
* Support the delivery of F\&B, hospitality, and entertainment operator agreements from a contracts and commercial perspective
* 
* **Leadership \& Team Building**
* Recruit, build, and mentor a multi\-disciplinary commercial team (quantity surveyors, contracts managers, commercial analysts)
* Foster a high\-performance, ethical, and collaborative commercial culture across the project
* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team
* Represent the project in dealings with government entities, master developers, and regulatory bodies where commercial matters arise



  





  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Essential
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in contracts and commercial management, with at least 5 years at Director level
* Proven experience on large\-scale retail, real estate, or mixed\-use destination development projects (total contract value ≥ QAR 500M)
* Deep expertise in FIDIC (Red, Yellow, Silver Books) and/or NEC contract suites
* Demonstrated track record in claims management, dispute avoidance, and commercial dispute resolution
* Experience building and leading commercial teams in a project delivery environment
* Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline
* 
* Highly Desirable
* MRICS / FRICS qualification or equivalent professional accreditation
* Prior experience on landmark GCC destination, leisure, or entertainment projects (e.g. Lusail City, Place Vendôme Qatar, Diriyah Gate, NEOM, Yas Island, Expo City)
* Familiarity with Qatari regulatory, procurement, and legal framework
* Experience with retail leasing commercial structures and entertainment/hospitality operator agreements
* Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not mandatory)
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be part of senior leadership responsible for independently leading and managing the Strategy Development team under Strategy and Business development department. Responsibilities include owning, leading, managing and executing the portfolio of strategy assignments for group wide business/ support divisions or countries across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision. These would be managing the full portfolio of strategy assignments such as full\-scale regional strategies, individual country strategies (for all applicable lines of business) or business unit strategies. The incumbent will also be responsible to support any specific requests and mandates coming from the Executive Management, including GCEO interviews, Board presentations and public documents.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Responsible for managing the portfolio of Group\-wide strategy assignments (domestic \& international)
* Develop metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for performance measurement and monitoring purposes related to assigned strategy and implementation projects on a periodic basis
* Own and lead the development as well as review of the financial plan for strategy assignments
* Assist the SEVP and EVP in identifying, analyzing and monitoring issues that impact or could affect the profitability, growth and productivity of the organization (domestic \& international).
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Senior Vice President, Strategy Development.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Own, lead and manage the portfolio of Group\-wide strategy assignments such as full scale regional strategies, individual country strategies (for all applicable lines of business) or business unit strategy development
* Ensure the integration of internal and external customer needs and requirements within the strategy assignments and implementation projects
* Lead the interactions with senior internal customers from business divisions, support divisions or country GMs for strategy assignments and implementation projects to ensure smooth management and alignment of deliverables
* Act as a reliable competent contact partner to all business, support divisions as well as country GMs within the delivery of strategy assignments and implementation projects
* Manage other Group Strategy\-related activities and mandates, such as supporting yearly business planning, performance management, development of strategic plans across QNB Group, GCEO interviews, Board presentations and preparation of other public documents as requested
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Obtain mandates, input and project brief on dedicated strategy assignment and implementation projects from SEVP and EVP
* Align scope, direction and deliverables of strategy assignments and implementation projects with EVP Strategy \& Business Development
* Lead multiple strategy projects simultaneously and supervise all project phases
* Develop and prepare set up of specific strategy assignments or implementation projects in terms of content, scope, structure, deliverables, timing, resources and work plans
* Manage project teams on a day\-to\-day basis to provide guidance, direction and supervision to the project teams to ensure timely high quality and impact delivery
* Guide the Vice Principal
* Strategy Development in the development of hypothesis formulation, analyses, market sizing and baselining exercises, formulation of frameworks and strategic recommendations as well as conclusions
* Review, discuss and align project deliverables with the project teams
* Assist the EVP Strategy \& Business Development in reviewing and providing feedback on the performance of the project team, as well as the section’s overall performance on a regular basis and making recommendations as necessary
* Supervise the Strategy Development team as established by the Group. These tasks include participating in the management of all HR issues related to the team such as: team performance, absence management, training needs identification and other requests
* Constantly endeavor to implement industry best practice standards within the development of strategic recommendations and governance frameworks.
* Bring in significant leadership to the division/department, ensuring that effective controls and resources are available to manage and control work volumes.
* Manage recruitment, provide motivation, guidance to employees and reinforce high standards concerning performance, and adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
* Manage strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives


**Continuous Improvement**
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify any areas for professional development of self and all direct reports, and act to enhance professional development of self and others
* Ensure the provision of relevant guidance, direction and training to subordinates to develop and enhance their skills
* Assess performance of direct reports and provide regular feedback on their development (including recognizing strengths and providing challenges)
* Demonstrate ability to provide the team with support, direction and vision, including motivating people to perform, listening to people
* Maintain a high level of knowledge about banking processes, regulations, and generally accepted operating practices. Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems \- Possess a superior knowledge of strategy and business development techniques/ tools and methodologies including various strategic frameworks, concepts and practices
* Complete all mandatory training or seminars provided by the Bank, in order to attain and maintain the required levels of competence
* Carry out other similar duties that can be defined within the broad functional job and functional responsibilities outlined above. These may include providing all necessary training to the department staff and handling special missions assigned by the management
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors / Masters (Masters preferred) and MBA from leading academic institution
* Minimum 15 years work experience with a demonstrable track record of at least 7 years in a strategy development role and most recently as a Senior Manager, either from top\-tier strategy consulting firms such as McKinsey \& Co, BCG, Bain \& Co, Booz \& Co, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger etc. or from a similar environment of a well\-renowned international financial services institution
* Demonstrated career development and progress, together with excellent team leadership skills and potential
* Proven track record and substantial management experience in managing and leading strategy assignments from concept to implementation
* High degree of analytical and methodological\-conceptual skills


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:

data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region
* Reports to the Director of Human Subjects Research


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges
* Strong networking and collaboration skills, with experience in building partnerships and engaging with external stakeholders
* Ability to present findings to stakeholders and effectively communicate with company leaders
* Excitement to work in a high\-energy, fast\-paced startup environment
* Understanding of branding and marketing as it applies to research in industry spaces
* Fluency in verbal and written English, WHOOP’s working language


**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
 Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.
   

  

 WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

**About HBKU**
 Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) is a member of Qatar Foundation for Education, Science, and Community Development (QF). The university was founded in 2010 to continue fulfilling QF’s vision of unlocking human potential. HBKU is a homegrown research\-intensive University offering undergraduate and graduate degrees that acts as a catalyst for positive transformation in Qatar and the region while having a global impact.
   

  

 Doha is the home of Education City (https://www.qf.org.qa/education/higher\-education), a dedicated campus devoted to research and education. In addition to HBKU, Education City hosts other academic institutions, including Weill Cornell Medicine\-Qatar, Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar, VCUarts Qatar, Northwestern University in Qatar, and Georgetown University in Qatar. Education City has significantly contributed to the development of post\-secondary education and cultural growth in Qatar.
   

  

**About Entity**
 Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) established the College of Public Policy in 2019\. The College has three degrees (Master of Public Policy, Master of Social Policy and Program Evaluation, Master of Global Health Policy) and Executive Programs (in collaboration with Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies in Geneva). The College works to empower the next generation of ethically grounded public leaders in Qatar and beyond. Students are given an inclusive and diverse learning environment that promotes a culture of excellence, integrity, respect, and fairness. All faculty members are active in research with broad agenda addressing national and global challenges and policy priorities.
   

  

 he Master of Global Health Policy (MGHP) program prepares graduates to address complex health challenges through policy analysis, interdisciplinary evidence, stakeholder engagement, ethical leadership, and public\-service\-oriented decision\-making. The program combines a strong foundation in global health systems, health economics, advocacy, crises and emergency settings, and research methods, while offering both a Capstone track and a Master’s Thesis track to support diverse professional and academic aspirations. Positioned at the intersection of public policy and global health, the MGHP program is designed to equip students with the knowledge, analytical tools, and practical skills needed to contribute to health policy development, implementation, and evaluation in Qatar, the region, and globally.
   

  

**Position:** 
 Full Professor
   

  

 To conduct teaching, research and service to contribute to HBKU becoming a world\-class research university and collaborate with faculty members and students to create a vibrant university community that will positively impact and contribute to the development of Qatar and the region by advancing knowledge in their field and developing human capacity through their teaching
   

  

**Job Description (In Bullet Points Only)**
* Provide academic, strategic, and administrative leadership for the Master of Global Health Policy (MGHP) program in advancing evidence\-based, policy\-relevant, and globally engaged education and research, aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030 and relevant international accreditation standards.
* Lead the continued development, review, and enhancement of the MGHP curriculum, including oversight of program quality assurance, accreditation\-related processes, and continuous improvement.
* Strengthen and expand partnerships with government entities, international organizations, health institutions, and other relevant stakeholders to support teaching, research, and policy engagement.
* Teach graduate\-level courses aligned with the MGHP Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs), including areas such as global health policy analysis, health systems, health economics, policy processes, culturally responsive communication, and ethical public\-service\-oriented leadership.
* Supervise graduate student capstone projects, master’s theses, and independent research in areas relevant to global health policy.
* Maintain an internationally recognized research profile in global health policy, health systems, health governance, health economics, or related fields.
* Lead and secure externally funded research projects, including national and international grants.
* Publish in high\-impact journals and contribute to regional and global debates in global health policy and public policy.
* Promote applied, policy\-relevant research that informs decision\-making and contributes to addressing health challenges in Qatar, the region, and globally.
* Mentor junior faculty and contribute to faculty development, research capacity building, and academic leadership within the College.
* Disseminate research findings through publications, policy reports, conferences, public engagement, and scholarly presentations to enhance the visibility and reputation of HBKU and the College.
* Perform other reasonable duties as assigned by the Dean or the University.


**Minimum Knowledge, Skills \& Experience (In Bullet Points Only)**
* PhD in Global Health Policy, Public Policy, Public Health, Health Economics, or a closely related field.
* Academic qualifications, scholarly standing, and professional experience commensurate with appointment at the rank of Full Professor.
* Distinguished record of high\-impact publications, externally funded research, graduate teaching excellence, and the ability to bridge research, teaching, and policy practice.
* Recognized expertise in global health systems, health policy, health governance, health economics, and/or applied policy analysis.
