data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Manager – Internal Audit Centre of Excellence (IA CoE) is responsible for strengthening the Internal Audit function through quality assurance, strategic planning, methodology development, digital enablement, and centralized resource management.
   

  

 The role acts as the strategic and operational backbone of the Internal Audit Unit, ensuring consistency, efficiency, innovation, and alignment with Global Internal Audit Standards (IPPF), while enabling delivery of high\-quality assurance and advisory services. across the organization.
   

  

**Position Information**
* Unit: Internal Audit
* Division: CAE
* Location: HQ


**Grade:** 
 L2
   

  

**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s in accounting /finance /business or related subjects. CIA certification is a must.
* Professional certification including CA, CPA, ACCA, CISA, will be highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 8 years of total experience \& at least 3 years in a managerial position.


**Key Accountabilities**
 Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program
   

  

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program (QAIP), develop and implement necessary quality assessment methodology, models, tools, etc.
* Ensure \& promote compliance with: IPPF / Global Internal Audit Standards, local regulations \& Internal audit methodology and policies.
* Perform ongoing internal quality assessment including individual engagement level assessments and implement improvements across the Unit.
* Conduct periodic quality reviews of Internal Audit Unit with respect to compliance with IPPF and local regulations.
* Facilitate external quality assessments.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement of audit quality.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Define and monitor KPIs and performance metrics for the Internal Audit function.
* Track audit delivery (Strategy \& Plan) against plans, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
* Support performance evaluation processes in coordination with audit leadership.
* Provide insights to CAE on productivity, utilization, and capability development.


 Risk Based Internal Audit Plan
   

  

* Coordinate development of the annual risk\-based internal audit plan after consolidating inputs from Business Units, Internal Audit teams, second line functions and Senior Management and Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise risks, regulatory requirements, and strategic priorities and recommend adjustments in the plan where necessary.
* Monitor performance and delivery of audit engagement against the plan and produce MIS.


 Internal Audit Strategy
   

  

* Support the CAE in developing and monitoring of Internal Audit Strategy, initiatives and roadmap.
* Coordinate and where necessary implement strategic initiatives.


 Standardization \& Operational excellence
   

  

* Custodianship of IA manual and ensures IAU activities are in compliance with regulatory and Global IA standards.
* Continuously review, enhance, and update Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, and processes to ensure alignment with best practices and drive operational excellence.
* Standardize audit approaches, templates, tools, and reporting formats across the function.
* Benchmark audit practices against leading industry standards and peers.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices across the function.


 Continuous Audit \& Digital Enablement
   

  

* Ensure the smooth delivery of continuous audit engagements and where possible coordinate to embed the output in the planned audit engagements.
* Enable and support audit teams through data analytics and automation.
* Ensure the digital enablement of the Unit (including use of emerging tech like AI) as per the IA Strategy.
* Oversee administration of the Audit Management System, including System configuration and enhancements, User access and governance and Integration of analytics and reporting capabilities
* Promote adoption of data\-driven auditing and digital tools across Internal Audit.


 Audit \& Risk Committee \& Executive Management Reporting
   

  

* Prepare and submit to CAE monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual MIS and other lAU performance related reports, including follow up / findings dashboard, internal quality assessment reports, state of lA report, etc.
* Assist CAE in preparation and administration of BAC Meetings.
* Provide insights on audit plan status, Key findings and themes, open findings, risk exposures and trends.
* Support CAE in presentation materials and stakeholder communications.
* Prepare and coordinate delivery of various awareness sessions on GRC \& Ethics.


 Follow\-Up Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate follow up and validation efforts to ensure timely closure and update of findings status.
* Centralize tracking of Internal Audit findings and management action plans.
* Monitor and report status of overdue and high\-risk issues.
* Escalate critical matters to CAE and senior management.


 Whistleblower Program \& Investigations
   

  

* Manage and coordinate investigations under the Whistleblower Program.
* Ensure investigations are conducted objectively, confidentially, and in line with policies.
* Coordinate with Legal, HR, and Compliance where required.
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and closure of cases.


 Resource Management /Audit Pool Administration
   

  

* Manage the centralized Internal Audit resource pool (\~20 staff). Schedule Audit engagements and serve as a focal point for consolidating individual engagement level assessment and leave management of the pool staff.
* Allocate resources to audit teams (GMs/SMs) based on audit priorities, skill requirements, capacity and utilization
* Oversee scheduling, utilization, and workforce planning.
* Manage administrative aspects including ERP\-related matters, timesheets, and coordination.


 Subsidiaries Audit Management \& Contract Governance
   

  

* Manage procurement and onboarding of outsourcing vendors for Internal Audit of unlisted subsidiaries in line with governance requirements.
* Coordinate closely with the appointed external audit service providers, Management of subsidiaries and respective GM Internal Audit to effectively plan, execute, and monitor audit activities across subsidiaries.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of audit dashboards and reports, including consolidation and escalation of key findings, to the Board Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and handle administrative matters including invoice verification and accurate cost chargeback to subsidiaries.


**Key Competencies**
**Leadership**
* Assertiveness and Conflict Resolution
* Fostering Learning and Development
* Inspiring and Leading Others
* Leading Change and Cultivates Innovation
* Visioning and Alignment


**Behavioral**
* Timely decision\-making
* Drives Achievements
* Ethics \& Compliance

**Role Purpose**
 The General Manager – Financial \& Operation Audit is responsible for leading the financial and operational audit, ensuring delivery of high\-quality, risk\-based assurance and advisory services across the organization, including domestic subsidiaries.
   

  

 The role supports the CAE in enhancing governance, risk management, and control processes, while ensuring coordination with second\-line functions, effective oversight of outsourced audit arrangements, and alignment with Global Internal Audit Standards (IPPF) and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Position Information**
* Unit: Internal Audit
* Division: CAE
* Location: HQ


**Grade**
* GM: L1


**Qualification**
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Candidates must hold at least one of the following professional certifications: CIA, CA, CPA, or ACCA.


**Experience**
* A minimum of 10 years of experience including 5 years in a senior management role in Internal Audit.


**Key Accountabilities**
**Audit Leadership \& Strategy**
* Support the CAE in developing and executing a risk\-based internal audit plan covering financial and operational domains across the group and subsidiaries.
* Ensure audit coverage reflects key enterprise risks, regulatory priorities, and business strategy.
* Provide strategic insights on emerging risks in financial and operational areas.
* Support the CAE in developing internal audit methodologies, processes, strategy and implementing strategic initiatives as assigned in the strategy.


**Oversight of Audit Engagement Lifecycle**
* Provide direction and oversight across the full audit lifecycle including Planning, execution, reporting, and follow\-up, with respect to allocated audit entities.
* Review and approve: Audit plans, risk assessments, audit programs, audit working papers.
* Review and recommend draft \& final internal audit reports for approval of the CAE.


**Advisory \& Consulting Engagements**
* Lead and oversee advisory engagements to support management in: Process improvements, Control design and optimization, Risk mitigation strategies, transformation initiatives, system implementation, pertaining to allocated audit entities.
* Provide independent and objective advice without compromising audit independence.
* Ensure advisory engagements follow defined governance and are clearly differentiated from assurance activities.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Ensure all audits adhere to: IPPF / Global Internal Audit Standards, Internal audit methodology and policies.
* Applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FSA, TRA).
* Oversee compliance with Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program (QAIP).
* Ensure audit files consistently meet quality expectations and pass internal/external reviews.


**Oversight of Subsidiary audit \& Outsourcing arrangements**

**Finding tracking \& Follow\-Up**
* Oversee monitoring and closure of audit findings across the group.
* Facilitate timely and effective implementation of management action plans.
* Escalate critical and overdue issues to CAE and senior leadership.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting**
* Act as a key interface between Internal Audit and senior management.
* Present audit outcomes, key themes, and risks to: CAE, Executive Management and Audit \& Risk Committee (as required).
* Drive constructive discussions on risk mitigation and control improvements.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Drive adoption of data analytics, automation, and digital audit tools.
* Benchmark audit practices against leading telecom operators and industry standards.
* Continuously improve audit methodologies, processes, and frameworks.


**Team Leadership \& People Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop Senior Managers and audit teams.
* Set performance objectives aligned with audit strategy and operational goals.
* Build capability in audit methodologies, data analytics, and industry best practices.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure development of a succession pipeline to support leadership continuity.


**Key Competencies**
**Leadership**
* Assertiveness and Conflict Resolution
* Fostering Learning and Development
* Inspiring and Leading Others
* Leading Change and Cultivates Innovation
* Visioning and Alignment


**Behavioral**
* Drives Achievements
* Ethics \& Compliance
* Timely Decision \- Making

data.jd_text:
The Manager / Senior Manager – Portfolio \& Asset Management will support the execution of Asyad Group’s portfolio management function. The role will focus on driving asset\-level performance visibility, detailed financial and operational analysis, value creation planning, turnaround support, and capital efficiency across Asyad’s portfolio companies and strategic investments.
 



 The role requires a strong analytical profile, preferably with significant Financial Due Diligence experience, and the ability to work closely with business units, finance teams, operating companies and senior management to identify performance gaps, challenge assumptions, and support value creation initiatives.
 



  





**Performance Monitoring \& Business Plan Review** 



* Monitor performance against budget across revenue, EBITDA, cash flow and capex, and flag key risks and variances.
* Prepare monthly/ quarterly structured asset review packs and performance dashboards for management and board reporting.
* Identify early warning signals and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and challenge annual business plans, budgets and forecasts submitted by portfolio companies.
* Validate key assumptions and assess alignment with strategy and value creation objectives.
* Evaluate capex plans and expected returns to support capital allocation decisions.



  





**Financial Analysis** 



* Perform detailed analysis of financial performance, covering revenue, margins, cost structure, working capital, cash generation and capital efficiency.
* Assess sustainability of earnings and identify key performance gaps and drivers.
* Build and maintain asset\-level financial models to support performance tracking and decision making.



  





**Value Creation \& Turnaround** 



* Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities across growth, cost optimization, asset utilization and cash improvement.
* Support turnaround of underperforming assets through structured action plans and performance tracking.
* Quantify impact of initiatives and monitor delivery against targets.



**Governance \& Shareholder Oversight** 



* Prepare shareholder materials, portfolio reviews and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
* Track board resolutions, shareholder actions and key governance matters across portfolio companies.
* Identify governance, reporting and control gaps and escalate where required.



**Capital \& Strategic Support** 



* Assess capital structure, funding requirements, returns and capital efficiency across assets.
* Support follow\-on investments, restructuring initiatives and divestment analysis.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level capital allocation and strategic review discussions



  





**Skills** 



* Hands\-on and analytical with strong FDD and financial analysis capability.
* Ability to challenge numbers, assumptions and business plans.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to convert detailed analysis into clear management recommendations.
* Commercial judgment and ability to link operational drivers to financial performance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business units and portfolio companies.
* High attention to detail and ability to work with incomplete or inconsistent data.
* Clear written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate independently and manage multiple assets/workstreams.



 English language is mandatory. Fluent in Arabic preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related field.
* Professional qualification preferred: CPA, ACCA, CFA, ACA or equivalent.
* MBA or advanced finance qualification is an advantage.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Financial Due Diligence / Transaction Services, private equity, portfolio management or corporate finance.
* Strong experience in financial analysis, business performance review and working with management accounts.
* Demonstrable strong financial modelling experience.
* Extensive knowledge of financial accounting concepts and corporate finance.

data.jd_text:
**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The HSE \& Process Safety Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), and Process Safety activities throughout the DRI Plant lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC), Commissioning, Start\-up, and Operations.
   

  

 The role ensures full compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and international best practices while establishing a strong safety culture and safeguarding personnel, assets, the environment, and business continuity. The position plays a critical role in managing construction safety risks, process safety hazards, and operational excellence within a high\-hazard industrial environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* **HSE Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and implement the overall HSE strategy for the DRI Plant project and operational phases.
* Establish HSE objectives, targets, KPIs, and improvement programs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, permits, corporate requirements, and international standards.
* Promote a Zero Harm culture across employees, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Provide HSE leadership to project, operations, maintenance, engineering, and contractor teams.
* **Construction HSE Management**
* Lead all HSE activities during site preparation, civil works, structural erection, mechanical installation, piping, refractory works, electrical and instrumentation construction.
* Review contractor HSE plans, risk assessments, method statements, and mobilization requirements.
* Monitor contractor compliance with project HSE requirements.
* Oversee high\-risk construction activities including:
+ Working at heights
+ Heavy lifting and crane operations
+ Confined space entry
+ Hot work
+ Excavation activities
+ Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS)
+ Electrical isolation

* Conduct HSE audits, inspections, and contractor performance evaluations.
* Drive proactive hazard identification and intervention programs.
* **Commissioning \& Start\-up Safety**
* Develop and implement commissioning and start\-up HSE programs.
* Ensure safe introduction of energy, process gases, utilities, and raw materials into the facility.
* Lead Pre\-Start\-up Safety Reviews (PSSR).
* Verify readiness of emergency systems, fire protection systems, gas detection systems, and critical safety barriers.
* Participate in commissioning risk assessments and operational readiness reviews.
* Ensure safe execution of plant start\-up activities.
* **Process Safety Management (PSM)**
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive Process Safety Management system.
* Lead hazard identification and risk assessment studies including:
+ HAZID
+ HAZOP
+ LOPA
+ Bow\-Tie Analysis
+ What\-if Studies

* Manage Management of Change (MOC) processes.
* Ensure integrity of Safety Critical Equipment and Safety Instrumented Systems.
* Support Asset Integrity and Mechanical Integrity programs.
* Lead investigations of process safety incidents and near misses.


 Special focus areas include:
   

  

* Natural gas systems
* Hydrogen\-rich reducing gas systems
* Reformer operations
* Reduction furnace operations
* High\-temperature process equipment
* Dust explosion prevention
* Fire and explosion risk management
* **Operational HSE Management**
* Lead HSE programs during plant operation.
* Ensure implementation of:
+ Permit to Work (PTW)
+ Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO)
+ Confined Space Entry
+ Working at Height
+ Hot Work Control
+ Contractor Safety Management

* Conduct routine HSE audits and workplace inspections.
* Monitor occupational health and industrial hygiene programs.
* Ensure emergency preparedness and response capability.
* **Environmental Management**
* Manage environmental compliance programs.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee:
+ Air emissions monitoring
+ Dust control systems
+ Wastewater management
+ Hazardous waste management
+ Resource efficiency programs

* Lead initiatives related to sustainability, decarbonization, and environmental performance improvement.
* **Incident Investigation \& Risk Management**
* Lead investigations of injuries, property damage, environmental incidents, and process safety events.
* Conduct root cause analysis using recognized methodologies.
* Develop and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain site risk registers and risk mitigation plans.
* **Emergency Response \& Crisis Management**
* Establish site emergency response systems.
* Lead emergency preparedness planning.
* Conduct drills for:
+ Fire and explosion scenarios
+ Gas release incidents
+ Hydrogen leaks
+ Confined space rescue
+ Medical emergencies

* Coordinate with external emergency response agencies and authorities.
* **Team Leadership**
* Build and lead the HSE organization for both project and operational phases.
* Develop HSE competencies throughout the workforce.
* Coach managers and supervisors in safety leadership and risk management.
* Support workforce engagement and behavioral safety initiatives.
* Support the Oman Project Director in all relevant tasks where requested.


**Requirements/ Skills/ Experience:**
* Experience in at least one of the following industries:
+ DRI / Ironmaking
+ Steel Manufacturing
+ Petrochemical
+ Refinery
+ LNG
+ Oil \& Gas
+ Power Generation

* Experience supporting EPC construction projects and operational facilities.
* Experience in commissioning and start\-up of industrial plants is highly preferred.


**Required Education/ Qualification/ Training:**
* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Occupational Health \& Safety, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 10 years of HSE experience in heavy industrial environments.
* Minimum 5 years in a management role.
* NEBOSH International Diploma
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* ISO 45001 Lead Auditor
* ISO 14001 Lead Auditor
* Process Safety Management Training
* Incident Investigation Certification


**Required Language Proficiency:**

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Project Manager to manage and support the delivery of software and digital transformation projects for the Oman Ministry of Education. The role will be responsible for coordinating project activities, following up with internal teams, managing stakeholders, tracking progress, and ensuring successful delivery within the agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the end\-to\-end delivery of software projects, from planning and requirements gathering to execution, monitoring, and go\-live.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Business Analysts, Developers, QA, UI/UX Designers, and implementation teams.
* Act as the main point of contact between internal teams, stakeholders, partners, and the client.
* Track project progress, timelines, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and follow\-up actions.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure clear communication across all project parties.
* Identify project risks and support in preparing mitigation plans.
* Ensure project deliverables are aligned with business requirements and quality expectations.
* Support resource planning and task prioritization with technical and business teams.
* Use project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, or similar tools to track tasks and deliverables.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in managing software, technology, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience in education, government, or large\-scale implementation projects is preferred.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum project delivery is preferred.
* Experience using project tracking tools such as Jira, MS Project, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.
* Good technical understanding of software platforms, integrations, cloud solutions, or modern development environments.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work under pressure.
* Arabic and English communication skills are required.
* Omani nationality is preferred; other nationalities may be considered based on experience and project fit.


**Preferred Certifications**
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or any project management certification is a plus.


**Required Experience**
 Minimum 4 years of experience in project management, preferably in software, EdTech, government, or digital transformation projects.

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Establish and operate the project's document control system across all engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Maintain the integrity, accessibility and traceability of all project documents exchanged between the owner's team, the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, lenders, regulatory authorities and other counterparties.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Establish, configure and operate the project's electronic document management system, covering all engineering, contractual, commercial, regulatory and HSE documentation.
* Define and enforce document numbering, revision control, status coding and approval workflows across the owner's team and external counterparties.
* Receive, log, distribute and track all incoming and outgoing project documents, including transmittals to and from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, lenders' independent technical advisors and Omani authorities.
* Maintain the project's master document register and ensure all document holders are working from current revisions.
* Manage the document approval cycle, ensuring timely turnaround between submission, review, comment and approval status across all disciplines.
* Support the preparation of document packages for major project milestones, including Final Investment Decision, lender due diligence, regulatory submissions and project financial close.
* Maintain the project's electronic and physical archive in line with the company's records retention policy and lender requirements.
* Support the discipline lead engineers and the Project Director with document retrieval, status reporting and audit trail evidence as required.
* Establish handover procedures for as\-built documentation from construction into operations.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 8 years' experience as a Document Controller on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Demonstrated experience operating an electronic document management system across multi\-party project environments involving owner, EPC contractors and technology licensors.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard document numbering and classification systems used in oil and gas, petrochemicals, steel or power projects.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence and audit processes is preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline and ability to maintain document integrity under high transaction volumes.
* Effective communication skills with engineering, commercial and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration or related discipline (required).
* Certification in document control, records management or project information management (e.g., AIIM, IRMS) (preferred).
* Proficiency in industry\-standard document management platforms (e.g. Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint, EDMS).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, integrate and maintain the project's master schedule across all phases from pre\-FID through commissioning of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Provide the Project Director, the company executive and the project's lenders with the integrated schedule view that supports decision\-making, risk management and financial close.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's master schedule, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, utility providers, port authorities and Omani regulatory counterparties.
* Consume and integrate the technology licensor's pre\-engineering Level 2 schedule and the integrated delivery partner's FEED and execution schedules into a single owner's master schedule.
* Manage interface dates and critical path dependencies across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, utility connections, port readiness and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain the project schedule baseline and track progress against baseline through earned value or equivalent reporting methods.
* Lead schedule risk analysis, including critical path analysis, float consumption tracking, and schedule contingency assessment.
* Prepare schedule reports for internal review, lender reporting and external stakeholder engagement, including the Project Director, the company executive, the lender consortium, and equity investors.
* Support the project's cost estimate development by providing schedule\-driven inputs into resource and cost loading.
* Support the project's risk management process by identifying schedule risks and supporting mitigation planning.
* Provide planning support to the discipline lead engineers in their interactions with the integrated delivery partner and equipment vendors.
* Maintain alignment between the project schedule and the project's regulatory, permitting and contractual milestones.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in project planning and scheduling on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience integrating multi\-party schedules across owner, technology licensor, EPC contractors and equipment vendors.
* Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule risk analysis and earned value management.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard scheduling software (Primavera P6 required; MS Project an advantage).
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on schedule deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate schedule status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management or related field (preferred).
* Project Management Professional (PMP), AACE Planning \& Scheduling Professional (PSP), or equivalent professional certification (preferred).
* Primavera P6 certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, validate and maintain the project's capital cost estimate across the pre\-FID and FEED phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman, to a level of accuracy sufficient to support Final Investment Decision and lender due diligence. Provide independent owner\-side cost estimating, quantity surveying and commercial assurance across the technology package, the integrated delivery partner's scope, and the broader project capex.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's capital cost estimate, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, port and utility infrastructure providers, and the owner's team.
* Triangulate, challenge and validate cost estimates produced by the technology licensor and the integrated delivery partner, providing independent owner\-side commercial assurance.
* Develop and maintain the project's bill of quantities for civil, structural, mechanical, piping and electrical scopes within the owner's review responsibility. Lead cost estimating accuracy improvement from order\-of\-magnitude through Class 3 to Class 2 estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice and lender expectations.
* Support the project's procurement strategy by developing should\-cost analyses, market price benchmarks and cost\-driver analyses for major equipment and construction packages.
* Maintain the project's cost contingency framework, including identification of cost risks, quantification of contingency requirements and reporting against contingency drawdown.
* Support the project's value engineering process by quantifying cost impacts of design alternatives and providing commercial input into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Support project finance lender due diligence by preparing cost estimate documentation packages and engaging directly with independent cost consultants engaged by the lender consortium.
* Provide cost reporting to the Project Director, the company executive and external stakeholders including lenders and equity investors.
* Support post\-FID cost control and change management by establishing the cost baseline, change control framework and earned value reporting structure.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in quantity surveying, cost estimating or cost engineering on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience developing FID\-grade and lender\-grade cost estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice (Class 3 or better).
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience providing independent owner\-side cost validation against contractor or licensor cost estimates.
* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based contracting, lump\-sum cost build\-ups, and reimbursable cost frameworks.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on cost estimate deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate cost status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Cost Engineering, Project Management or related field (preferred).
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) or AACE International Certified Cost Professional (CCP) (preferred).
* AACE Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP) or Estimating Professional (EVP) certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

 Revenue Growth \& Financial Performance

 Digital Transformation \& Process Optimization

data.raw_snippet: We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia
data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

**About The Role**
 Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, you will define and execute our data and AI strategy, ensuring that our platforms, capabilities, and insights deliver measurable impact across the resort. You will lead the design and implementation of scalable data architectures, oversee advanced analytics initiatives, and evaluate and deploy AI\-driven solutions that enhance decision\-making and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership and business stakeholders, you will translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value, while establishing robust governance, security, and data management practices.

* Identify and implement AI and machine learning use cases that enhance guest experience, revenue, and operational performance

* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure ROI and impact of data and AI initiatives
* Create compelling dashboards, visualisations, and data narratives for senior leadership
* Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement across IT and business teams


**About You**
 You are a senior data and technology leader with a strong blend of technical expertise and commercial acumen. You bring deep experience in data engineering, analytics, and enterprise platforms, alongside a proven ability to translate data into meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

* Strong expertise in data warehousing, data pipelines, and analytics

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

data.jd_text:
**JOB TITLE:** 
 Payments Transformation Lead
 








**LOCATION:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 








**OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Payments Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead the design and development of large\-scale, multi\-country payment infrastructure initiatives across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
 



 This role will play a critical part in shaping next\-generation payment schemes and digital payment ecosystems, supporting clients, governments, financial institutions, and payment stakeholders across the region.
 








**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Define modern, multi\-instrument payment architectures (cards, wallets, mobile money, and QR payments).
* Design solutions covering:



 \- Switching, routing, and authorization.
 



 \- Unified back\-office processing (clearing, reconciliation, and settlement).
 



 \- API\-first and ISO 20022\-based ecosystems.
 


* Translate complex requirements into structured, compelling proposals.
* Incorporate MEA market realities and multi\-country deployment considerations into solution designs.
* Contribute to scheme economics, licensing models, and governance frameworks.
* Lead end\-to\-end RFP response development, including technical, functional, and commercial inputs.








**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** 



* 12–15 years of experience in payments, fintech, banking, or transaction processing environments.
* Proven experience in designing and implementing large\-scale payment infrastructures and ecosystems.
* Strong expertise across:



 \- Card payments (issuing, acquiring, processing, and schemes).
 



 \- Mobile money ecosystems.
 



 \- Digital wallets and QR payments.
 



 \- POS, ATM, e\-commerce, and omnichannel payment acceptance.
 


* Deep knowledge of:



 \- ISO 8583, ISO 20022, APIs, EMVCo, and PCI DSS.
 


* Mandatory experience working across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
* Proven track record of leading or contributing to successful RFP, bid, and proposal responses.








**WHY JOIN US** 



* Opportunity to shape a next\-generation, transaction\-based regional payment scheme that extends beyond traditional card payments.
* Work on a multi\-vertical payments ecosystem spanning banking, mobile money, and digital services.
* High\-impact, strategic role with significant ownership and influence.

 • Experience coordinating with vendors, internal stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams across multiple markets.
 



 • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, settlements, reconciliation, reporting, and operational controls.

 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global environment with multiple priorities and stakeholders.
 



 • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks across MENA, EU, and APAC regions is a plus.

* Work with one of the world’s leading financial derivatives institutions.

 Win with grit

 Create positive energy
   

  

 Maybe, even have fun

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 finera is seeking a Merchant Settlements Officer to join the Finance team in Dubai. This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of merchant settlement processes across payment systems and internal financial records.
   

  

 The position plays a key role in managing day\-to\-day settlement operations, supporting merchant fund flows, and resolving settlement\-related queries and discrepancies. You will work closely with Finance, Operations, Account Management, and payment partners to maintain financial control, ensure settlement transparency, and deliver a high standard of merchant support.
   

  

 Operating within a fast\-paced fintech environment, the role also provides exposure to multi\-currency and digital asset (cryptocurrency) settlement environments, including interaction with modern custody and wallet infrastructure.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field


**Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in merchant settlements, payments operations, or financial operations
* Experience in fintech, payments,  or high\-volume transaction environments is preferred
* Exposure to digital asset or  cryptocurrency settlement environments is advantageous


**Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Experience with accounting or ERP systems (e.g., Xero, Oracle NetSuite, or similar platforms)
* Understanding of payment processing systems, settlement flows, FX applications, and reconciliation practices
* Familiarity with digital asset platforms such as Fireblocks or Utila is an advantage
* Strong proficiency in integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation


**Competencies**
* Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy
* Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies
* Ability to clearly communicate financial concepts to non\-finance stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in cryptocurrency or  digital asset settlement operations
* Familiarity with merchant  acquiring and payment gateway ecosystems


**Job Responsibilities**
**Merchant Settlement Execution \& Fund Flow Management**
* Execute daily merchant settlement processes, ensuring timely and accurate fund transfers
* Manage and monitor settlement flows across payment processors, banking partners, and internal systems
* Validate settlement amounts, deductions, and net payouts to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Monitor settlement cycles (e.g., T\+N structures) and ensure adherence to agreed timelines
* Ensure accuracy of fund flows to mitigate financial and operational risk


**Settlement Reconciliation \& Validation**
* Perform reconciliation of  settlement data across processors, internal systems, and reports
* Validate transaction and  settlement data to ensure consistency across multiple data sources
* Identify and investigate  discrepancies related to settlements, fees, and transaction activity
* Support resolution of  reconciliation breaks impacting merchant settlements.


**Account Monitoring \& Financial Controls**
* Act as a key point of contact for Account Management teams on settlement\-related matters
* Respond to and resolve merchant  queries related to:
	+ settlement statements and transaction breakdowns
	+ FX conversions and rate applications
	+ rolling reserves and reserve releases
	+ fees, deductions, and net settlement calculations
	+ balance confirmations and outstanding positions
	+ settlement schedules, payout timelines, and funding cycles (T\+N structures)
* Provide clear, accurate explanations of settlement flows, balances, and financial adjustments
* Support Account Management in maintaining strong merchant relationships through timely and effective query resolution


**Account Monitoring \& Financial Controls**
* Monitor merchant accounts for  irregularities, outstanding balances, and settlement issues
* Maintain and update records of  rolling reserves, settlement positions, and outstanding balances
* Conduct due diligence checks to  validate merchant financial details and safeguard fund flows
* Ensure adherence to internal  financial controls and operational procedures
* Identify and escalate settlement  risks or financial exposure where required


**Reporting \& Data Accuracy**
* Prepare daily and periodic  settlement reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy of financial data
* Maintain structured and auditable  records of settlement activities
* Highlight discrepancies, trends,  or risks impacting settlement accuracy and timelines
* Support accurate and complete reporting of all merchant\-related transactions across multiple platforms, ensuring readiness for financial control review, audit requirements, and  regulatory compliance


**Process Improvement \& Operational Efficiency**
* Identify opportunities to improve settlement workflows, accuracy, and operational efficiency
* Support the implementation of  process enhancements and automation initiatives
* Work with Finance and Operations teams to reduce manual processes and improve scalability
* Contribute to building robust and efficient settlement frameworks as transaction volumes grow


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Account Management, and external partners to ensure smooth settlement processes
* Liaise with payment processors, banks, and digital asset platforms to resolve settlement\-related issues
* Support onboarding of new merchants or payment partners by aligning settlement and reporting requirements


**Job Benefits**
* Competitive salary package aligned with experience and market standards.
* Medical Insurance starting from day 1\.
* Access to training resources and development opportunities that support your professional growth.
* Well\-stocked office with snacks, drinks, and refreshments available daily.
* A multinational organisation that promotes a strong, collaborative culture
* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

 The Mauritius Commercial Bank Ltd (MCB) is the leading financial institution in Mauritius and a key player in the African banking landscape. As part of the largest banking group in Mauritius (MCB Group) and with over 187 years of history, MCB has built a strong reputation for innovation, customer\-centric solutions, and financial stability.
 



  





 Under its Vision 2030 strategic plan, MCB is pursuing a deliberate strategy of focusing on specialized, high\-expertise niche segments across the African continent while also leveraging on its hubs in Nairobi, Johannesburg, Lagos, Paris and Dubai.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As
 **Head of Digital Assets and Emerging Technologies** 
 , you will embark on a journey with our
 **Customer Experience \& Marketing SBU** 
 , where the shared ambition is to craft a brand that deeply resonates with its audiences, providing them with a simple, personalized, and meaningful experience.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Chief Customer Experience Officer (CXO) and will have direct accountability over two streams: (1\) the existing AI COE team, providing strategic direction and governance over the bank's artificial intelligence capabilities; and (2\) a new Digital Assets team, responsible for building the bank's position in virtual assets, custody, blockchain, stablecoins, and tokenisation.
 



  





 The role combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution authority, interfacing with the Board, regulators, leadership team, lines of business, strategic partners, and clients.
 



  





**📍Location: Mauritius (Preferred) \| Hybrid: Mauritius / Dubai** 




  





**The Role** 




 Enterprise Strategy \& Roadmap
 


* Define and continuously evolve the Emerging Technologies strategy and three\-year execution roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and manage a structured innovation pipeline: use\-case identification, prioritization, business cases, and scaling paths across lines of business.
* Establish clear value\-tracking for initiatives and report progress and portfolio KPIs to CXO/ governance forums.



  





 AI Leadership

* Drive responsible AI by embedding risk, model governance, and regulatory readiness into AI solution design and deployment.
* Expand AI capabilities into high\-value domains and ensure solutions meet customer and business requirements.



  





 Digital Assets Leadership
 


* Create and scale the bank’s Digital Assets agenda including tokenization, custody, stablecoin\-related propositions, partnerships, and future\-fit solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end product and solution development for Digital Asset services: target operating model, product architecture, ecosystem partner selection, and go\-to\-market coordination
* Monitor market and regulatory evolution and translate developments into actionable roadmap decisions.



  





 Governance, Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Engagement (Portfolio\-wide)
 


* Embedded the governance framework for the Emerging Technologies portfolio: policies, controls, risk registers and compliance requirements.

* Build/maintain procedures with Risk, Compliance, Legal, AML and Technology to ensure products and platforms meet internal and external obligations.



  





 Stakeholder, Board \& Ecosystem Leadership

 Budget, Operating Discipline \& Delivery Execution

* Establish delivery governance: portfolio cadence, project/program controls, resourcing allocation, and corrective actions when needed.



  





 Organization \& Capability Building

**The Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as IT, engineering, or finance.

**Overview**
 The ITS Director for Fare Collection Systems with a minimum of 12 years senior technical and management experience and a university degree, shall be responsible for the overall management, performance, and integration of the fare collection system of the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) across the Public Transport Network. This includes AFC (Automatic Fare Collection), CCC (Customer Contact Center) and associated systems and interfaces, including integration with external stakeholders such as the Metro Network. He shall ensure that the interfaces between the ITS Contractors and the other project transport operators are efficient and implemented in sufficient time to allow for the smooth operation of the Bus and metro systems. He shall be responsible for all ITS\-related technical deliverables on behalf of the Employer and shall ensure that no scope or responsibility gaps exist across Contractors or systems. He shall be responsible for system performance, revenue management, Central Clearing House, stakeholder reporting, vendor management and compliance with RCRC/contract obligations. The role ensures that all ITS systems operate efficiently, meet contractual KPIs, and support seamless public transport operations across around 1,000 metro and bus stations.

* Oversee the performance, reliability of the Fare collection systems including AFC, CCC as well as all integration with AVM and Journey Planning systems.
* Ensure effective interface management between Bus Contractors, ITS Contractors, and external systems and stakeholders such as Metro.
* Monitor system performance and resolve inconsistencies, faults, and integration issues.
* Ensure robust revenue collection and management processes are implemented between the operators and the Client finance department.
* Ensure contractors meet contractual KPIs and performance targets.
* Oversee maintenance, backup, cybersecurity, and data protection practices for all systems.
* Lead vendor and contractor management related to ITS systems.
* Ensure proper implementation of software management best practices and data security requirements.
* Review and approve all technical deliverables submitted by ITS contractors.

data.jd_text:
TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Lead the development of AI\-enabled products across credit decisioning, fraud and risk monitoring, dynamic limit management, and inventory and cashflow intelligence.
* Translate complex, real\-world data into decision tools that improve accuracy, reduce loss rates, and responsibly expand access to finance.
* Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and operate a modern data and ML platform covering ingestion, feature pipelines, training, serving, experimentation, and monitoring.
* Define AI work streams, milestones, and measurable outcomes; including approval lift, loss reduction, time\-to\-decision, and merchant growth impact.
* Establish technical standards across code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation.
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions across infrastructure, data providers, scoring components, KYC tooling, and payment rails.
* Hire, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh.
* Build strong security and privacy foundations that can withstand audits and support future licensing requirements.
* Partner closely with Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Partnerships teams.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.
* You bring strong software engineering fundamentals alongside hands\-on experience in machine learning and data platforms.
* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

data.jd_text:
TheSoul Group is a global media company with over a decade of experience building and operating digital businesses at scale. With a presence across 60 platforms, content distributed in 21 languages, and more than 100 billion monthly views, we have established one of the largest and most operationally sophisticated media footprints in the world. Our remote\-first team, spanning 85\+ countries, has grown by solving — at real scale — the exact organisational and operational challenges most companies struggle with.
   

  

 That operational depth is the foundation of Valis — TheSoul Group's brand new business and AI platform for enterprise transformation. Valis is an institutional AI operating layer for mid\-market organisations (roughly 200\-2,000 employees). It sits across a company's systems, runs one shared, org\-wide "brain" on everything the company knows, and applies encoded operator judgment on every answer — so the value of AI compounds for the company, not just for individuals using per\-seat chatbots.
   

  

 Valis is already proven in production — built from real transformation work, encoding operational experience rather than theory — and we are now scaling its deployment to mid\-market companies worldwide.
   

  

 We are seeking a Client Deployment Lead, AI to embed on\-site alongside mid\-market CEOs and make their AI\-Native transformation real on the ground. You work as a tight pod: you on\-site owning the CEO relationship and the result and you drive the rollout to a finance\-verified outcome, with elite remote engineers shipping the product configuration behind you. Every CEO who watches you land the transformation becomes the proof that wins the next one. This role is the engine of our go\-to\-market.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the client\-CEO relationship and the executive steering committee — as a peer, with real decision rights
* Run the transformation cadence: weekly reviews, monthly finance\-verified value reviews, and quarterly business reviews
* Drive a fast, fixed\-scope first win on the client's real data, then lead the full rollout (leadership first, then the wider team)
* Translate client problems into crisp, build\-ready specs for remote engineers; own adoption and sign\-off
* Be personally accountable for a finance\-verified outcome the client can see in their P\&L
* Build a portfolio of 2\-3 marquee CEO accounts as each engagement matures
* Own end\-to\-end rollout management — from kick\-off through adoption, sign\-off, and handover — ensuring every phase lands on time and to a measurable outcome
* Codify the method after each deployment so the next one requires less ramp\-up


**Requirements**
* A track record of owning real outcomes — you have moved a P\&L or shipped a transformation, not just advised on one
* CEO\-room presence: ability to sit across from a mid\-market CEO as a peer and earn organisational trust quickly
* Technically literate enough to prototype, spec work, and direct engineers — you shape the solution, you don't wait for one
* You thrive in ambiguity — operating effectively with incomplete information, shifting requirements, and no fixed playbook
* Willing and energised to be on\-site with clients (:30\-60% travel)
* Likely background: top\-tier strategy firm (Engagement Manager → Associate Partner) or a proven in\-house transformation operator
* Hands\-on experience with AI / data tooling is a strong plus


**Benefits**
* Compensation: A competitive base calibrated to your market and seniority, plus a performance bonus tied to delivered outcomes
* Equity: Meaningful, founder\-tier ownership — this is the real upside, and it's sized to match
* Authority: Real decision rights and an interim\-executive mandate inside the client where granted. You own the result
* Trajectory: A portfolio of marquee CEO relationships and a clear path to Regional GM for MENA
* Location: On\-site with the client during deployment (:30\-60% travel across the MENA region); your home base is flexible
* Why AI makes this seat more valuable, not less: Valis automates the coordination, reporting and status layer of a company. This role sits on the other side of that line: CEO trust, judgment under ambiguity, and accountability for a real outcome are exactly what don't automate. As the platform gets stronger, the seat compounds in leverage — it doesn't erode

Due to the high volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. However, if your qualifications align with our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the next steps in the selection process.
